en.text:
---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Get my stuff here](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: Get my models here](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

## Nodes

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node. Drag inside the source to reposition it. **free** or locked to a common aspect ratio, grey fill. Outputs **control_image**, **control_mask** (white = new area), **mask_image**, **width**, **height**. **hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** puts the box back on the image every run and passes the image through as is (so a new image always starts clean); **held** keeps the canvas you set up and passes the image through with it. **block** set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream when the mask is empty: with snap_to_image that means every run (drag the edges out, switch to held, run again), with held only if you have not pulled an edge out. Run once to get the preview. *note:* **snap_to** rounds the final size up to a multiple (8 by default), set it to 1 to turn that off. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draw a mask right on the node. Click to add points (no limit), drag to move, shift+click removes one. Flip the toggle to **pencil** for freehand. **smooth**, **invert**, **feather**, and **opacity** are built in. Undo and Clear buttons on the node. **block** (top widget) set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream until you have drawn something, same idea as Impact Pack's Preview Bridge. Run once to get the preview. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tighten a mask with a **trimap**. **edge_erode** pulls the sure-foreground in from the mask edge, **edge_dilate** sets how far the unknown band reaches out. Only that band is decided by the **method** (**vitmatte** for hair and fine detail, **guided_filter** for speed, or **none**), so a narrower band means a tighter mask. Also **grow** (negative shrinks), **fix_gap**, **black_point** / **white_point**, **feather**, and **edge_color_spread** to cut background halos on the cutout. Plug a mask into **detail_region** (like hair) to give just that area a wider trimap (**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **trimap**. Before/after wipe on the node, same as the LC123 previews: hover and the after image sits left of the pointer. **preview_view** switches between cutout, mask and trimap. Run once to get the preview. 💡 Start with 10 / 10, then shrink both toward 3 for a tight edge. **Micro adjust:** every pixel value (**grow**, **fix_gap**, **edge_erode**, **edge_dilate**, the **detail_** ones, **feather**) takes decimals in 0.1 px steps, the points step by 0.001, and the edges are true circles, not blocks. Wire sliders in as **FLOAT** (INT sockets will not plug into these). ⚠️ Numbers are real pixels. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Cut the subject out with a BiRefNet model. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, and **on_background** (subject on a solid color). Optional **refine** (guided_filter or vitmatte) with the same trimap controls (**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**), plus **grow**, **black_point** / **white_point**, and **feather**. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Uses ComfyUI's built-in background-removal loader, so no extra dependency. 💡 Raise **black_point** to clear faint haze, use **vitmatte** for hair. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Place a layer on a background and blend it. **x_percent** / **y_percent** (0.01 steps), **scale**, **aspect_ratio**, **rotate**, **mirror**, and 29 blend modes, with **opacity** in 0.1 steps and an optional **layer_mask** (multiplied with the layer's own alpha). **background_image** is optional: leave it off and the layer goes on a transparent canvas the size of the layer (RGBA out, like LayerStyle's V3). **transform_method**: lanczos, bicubic, bilinear, nearest. Outputs **image** and **mask** (where the layer landed). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Select things by describing them: type **hair, eyes, bikini** and each word is found and combined. **engine**: **grounding_dino + sam** (GroundingDINO finds boxes, SAM makes masks) or **sam3** (SAM 3 does both, using ComfyUI's built-in SAM 3 support). Then the same refine as Mask Refine (**refine**, **edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**, **black_point** / **white_point**) and a before/after wipe on the node. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For sam3, **sam3_threshold** 0.5 is a good start; near 0.3 it invents matches for words that are not in the image. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Pick the parts of a person: **face**, **hair**, **body**, **clothes**, **accessories**, **background**, combined into one mask. **engine**: **segformer** (higher resolution, body is arms and legs only) or **mediapipe** (body includes torso and neck skin). Then the same refine as Mask Refine. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For skin work, enable **face** and **body**. |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels. **mode**: **RGB** (each channel on its own, also removes color casts), **lum + sat**, **luminance**, **saturation**, or **mono**. Then **red** / **green** / **blue** balance, **brightness**, **contrast**, **saturation** trims, and **strength** to blend back toward the original. All in 0.1 steps. An optional **mask** limits both where the levels are measured and where the result is applied (an alpha channel works as the mask when none is connected). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth map from one image, normalized 0-1 per image, **bright = near** unless **invert** is on. Reads the original Depth Anything V2 weights, so a copy you already have in `models/depthanything` works (it also finds the ones in comfyui_controlnet_aux). Outputs **depth** (3-channel image) and **depth_mask**. **resolution** in steps of 14. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's Depth Anything V2 (correlation 1.000). Model code is vendored, no extra package. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Surface normal map (RGB = XYZ) with the BAE network, the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. **resolution**, and **flip_y** for OpenGL vs DirectX. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's BAE (correlation 0.9999). Needs the `timm` package (the installer adds it if missing). 💡 Both maps are what LC Lighting Control in LC123 wants as its **depth_map** and **normal_map**. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well, not a blind centre crop: one render, every social format, nobody's head cut off. **aspect_ratio** uses the same presets as LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (or **custom**). **framing**: **widest** keeps as much picture as the format allows; **upper body**, **head & shoulders** and **face** frame tighter from the face size (character datasets). **faces**: **all** keeps every face in the crop, **largest** frames the main one (use it when posters or background people get picked up). **output_size**: **preset size** (e.g. 1080x1350) or **keep pixels**. SAM 3 finds the faces; wire a **mask** to frame anything else (a car, a product, a pet). Nothing found: a centre crop, and the console says so |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. The round handle turns it (hold **Shift** for 15° steps, or type the **angle**), the frame's square handles pad (drag out) or crop (drag in), and dragging inside the frame moves the picture. The **control_mask** is white where the model has to paint: the padding and the corners a turn opens up, so it goes straight into **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**. **fit**: **expand** starts the frame around the whole turned picture, **crop** at the largest box with no empty corners. **fill**: **gray** (what Krea 2 and AnyPaint expect), **edge** (stretches the outer pixels), **white**, **black**. **aspect** locks the output shape, **snap_to** rounds the size up. Straight and quarter turns copy pixels, never resample. **block**: **until turned or framed** stops the run after this node while the picture is untouched, so the first run only puts the picture on the node; **never** always passes it on. **keep_frame**: **keep (same image)** holds the turn and frame run after run (post processing the same picture), **snap back after run** resets them once a run finishes so the next image starts clean. Run once to see the picture on the node. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with yijunwang2's **AnyPaint LoRA** ([Here](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint), put it in your loras folder), run the way it was trained. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. The model sees a small copy of the whole picture while it paints, so the new part matches the light and the scene, and a thin border around the mask is redrawn so the seam disappears. **prompt**: describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. **crop_to_mask** on for inpaint (the area is redrawn in its own crop at **inpaint_resolution**), off for outpaint. **composite**: **keep original** pastes back only the painted area, **raw** is the whole redraw. Use Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1. 💡 "Remove the car" leaves a flat blob: describe what should be there instead. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for **Z-Image** (Turbo / Base): the same crop, keep, border and seam fix, painted by Alibaba's **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** in inpaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1), put it in models/model_patches; the 8steps one is for Turbo). The only difference from the Krea 2 node is the top two widgets: **control** (the union patch) and **control_strength**. Describe the whole finished picture in the prompt. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any **SDXL** checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious, your finetunes), no LoRA needed. Painted by xinsir's **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** in repaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0), put the promax file in models/controlnet). **prompt**: describe what goes in the mask, short ("a red bucket full of fish on the pier"). To remove something, describe what should be there instead, or leave it empty and it fills from the picture around the mask (outpaint still wants the scene described). SDXL uses a real **negative** and **cfg** (25 steps, cfg 5, dpmpp_2m / karras). **fooocus_inpaint** (optional, off by default): lllyasviel's Fooocus inpaint patch ([Here](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint), models/inpaint, needs Acly's **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**) blends best on outpaints and fills but rebuilds what was there more than it adds. ⚠️ With both on, drop **control_strength** to about 0.5: Pony and Illustrious turn to noise at 1. ⚠️ **Outpaint: control_strength about 0.2.** At 1 the straight edge of the old picture reads as a real edge, and SDXL paints a window frame, fence or line along it. Inpaint stays at 1 (the mask is surrounded by your picture, so it holds the light and edges through the hole). 💡 A boolean and two floats into **control_strength** switches it with your inpaint / outpaint toggle. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer chain with one node. Finds what you type (**hands, face, eyes**) with SAM 3 and redraws it at full detail. Each hand or face gets its own crop, scaled to about **inpaint_resolution** squared pixels, redrawn, then blended back in. The redraw reaches a little past the pasted area and its colour is matched to the original along the seam, so the edge does not show. **tone_match** (on): the redraw gets the original's brightness, contrast and colour back where it is pasted, keeping the new detail (a light redraw otherwise comes back flat and dull); turn it off when the redraw is meant to change colours. Changing denoise, steps or feather redraws without searching again. **grow** / **feather** shape the mask, **padding** is the context around each crop, **blend** mixes the original back in (1 = all redraw). Works with 4-D and 5-D latents (SDXL, Flux, Krea 2, Anima, Qwen, etc.). Leave **negative** empty for cfg 1 models, wire it for SDXL. Nothing found? The image passes through untouched and the node says so. Before/after wipe on the node with the found areas outlined. **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** takes the image, model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe; wire an **image**, **model** or **vae** into it to use that one instead (a node without a pipe changed the picture, a model with LoRAs on it, or a different model). It puts its result back in the pipe's image and leaves two things for the nodes after it: every area the detailers redrew (merged, so face + hands + eyes add up), which **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** carries to the new size (its **protected** output), and what SAM 3 found, so the same word is never searched twice. Both are tied to the picture they were made for and ignored if it changed in between. 💡 Faces: denoise 0.3, blend 0.8. **cfg** defaults to 1 on both versions (the pipe version no longer takes the main sampler's cfg_1, which made redraws drastic). 1 works for Krea 2, Flux, Z-Image and, at detailer denoise up to about 0.4, SDXL too (tested cfg 1 to 7: the same result). It never goes below 1: below 1 the redraw comes out speckled. 💡 If your positive describes the whole scene, wire a short prompt for the area into **inpaint_positive** (e.g. "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin"). Otherwise, at denoise 0.3 and up, the scene can get drawn into every crop. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Upscale that keeps the detailers' work. VOSR 2.0 (one step, built in, no other pack needed) sharpens and adds fine detail to the picture it is given instead of redrawing it with your model, so faces and hands come through as the detailers left them, with no new skin blotches. Run it **after** the detailers: render → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**. **upscale_by** 1.5x, 2x, 3x or 4x in one pass, 6x (3x + 2x) and 8x (4x + 2x) in two (one big pass breaks the skin up into patches), **color_alignment** wavelet keeps the colours, **tile_size** 512 (what it was trained at), **vae_tile_size** lower = less VRAM. **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** takes the picture from the LC pipe (what the detailers left in it) and puts the result back, one wire after **LC Smart Detailer (pipe)**. Its **protected** output is the detailers' areas at the new size: wire it into LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale **protect_mask** so they do not add skin detail on top of the detailers' work (the plain version takes LC Smart Detailer's **mask** as **protect_mask** and gives the same output). 2x of a 1 MP picture: about 5 s and under 7 GB on an RTX 5090. Weights download on first run (about 6.5 GB). |

---

## Models and licensing

- ✋ Models are **never bundled or redistributed**. Model-backed nodes download from the original source the first time you use them, or reuse a copy you already have.
- Each model in a dropdown is labelled with its license, so you can see what you are picking.
- **VITMatte** (LC Mask Refine): `vitmatte-small-composition-1k` and `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`, both Apache-2.0. Saved under `models/vitmatte`. A copy you already have in `models/vitmatte` is picked up automatically.
- **BiRefNet** (LC Remove Background): general, matting, portrait, and HR 2048 variants, all MIT. Saved under `models/background_removal`, the same folder ComfyUI's own loader reads.
- **RMBG-2.0** (BRIA): used if you already have it in `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0`. Not downloaded for you. ⚠️ Non-commercial license.
- Older BiRefNet `.pth` files (like `BiRefNet-ep480.pth`) use an older layout that ComfyUI cannot load, so they are not listed.
- **GroundingDINO + SAM** (LC Segment Anything): `grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base` and `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`, all Apache-2.0, Hugging Face format. Saved under `models/grounding-dino` and `models/sam`. Your original-format `.pth` files there are not used (different layout).
- **SAM 3** (LC Segment Anything, sam3 engine): Meta's original `facebook/sam3` is gated (manual approval), so it is never downloaded for you. Your own `sam3.safetensors` in `models/sam3` (or ComfyUI's `models/detection`) is picked up. For a one-click option, the dropdown offers **SAM 3.1** (`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`, 1.7 GB) from `Comfy-Org/sam3.1`, the same ungated copy ComfyUI's own SAM 3 template uses, saved to `models/sam3`. SAM License terms apply (Hugging Face lists it as *other*).
- **Segformer clothes** (LC Person Mask): `mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`, saved under `models/segformer_b2_clothes`. ⚠️ Its Hugging Face card says license *other* and it is built on NVIDIA's SegFormer, so treat it as **not cleared for commercial use** until you have checked.
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass** (LC Person Mask): Google's `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`, saved under `models/mediapipe`. Check its model card for terms. The `mediapipe` Python package is not installed by this pack.
- **Depth Anything V2** (LC Depth Anything V2): **Small is Apache-2.0**, **Base / Large / Giant are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial)**. Saved under `models/depthanything`. Small is listed first so it is the default.
- **BAE normals** (LC Normal Map): `scannet.pt` from lllyasviel/Annotators, saved under `models/normalbae`. ⚠️ Trained on ScanNet and the Hugging Face card only says *other*. Treat as **not cleared for commercial use** until you have checked.
- ⚠️ Some models are **non-commercial**. The label tells you. Checking the license before commercial use is on you.

---

Third-party model code in `vendor/` is credited in [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md).

@[card: 关注我](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: 关注我](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: 在这里获取我的作品](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: 在这里获取我的模型](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: 请我喝杯 ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### 这是花了很多个小时做出来的。如果你喜欢，请 👍 点赞、💬 留言，也欢迎 ⚡ 打赏 😉

---

## 节点

| 节点 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | 在节点上把画布边缘往外拖，在原图内部拖动可重新定位。**free** 或锁定为常用宽高比，灰色填充。输出 **control_image**、**control_mask**（白色 = 新增区域）、**mask_image**、**width**、**height**。**hold_mask**：**snap_to_image** 每次运行都会把框放回图像上，并原样透传图像（所以新图总是从干净状态开始）；**held** 保留你设置好的画布，并带着它透传图像。**block** 设为 **if_empty_mask** 时，遮罩为空就会停掉下游的一切：用 snap_to_image 意味着每次运行都会停（把边缘拖出去，切到 held，再运行一次），用 held 则只有在你没拉出任何边缘时才会停。先运行一次才会出预览。*注意：* **snap_to** 会把最终尺寸向上取整到某个倍数（默认 8），设为 1 即可关闭。 |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | 直接在节点上画遮罩。点击添加点（数量不限），拖动移动，shift+点击删除一个。把开关切到 **pencil** 就是手绘。内置 **smooth**、**invert**、**feather** 和 **opacity**。节点上有撤销和清除按钮。**block**（最上面的控件）设为 **if_empty_mask** 时，在你画出东西之前会停掉下游的一切，思路和 Impact Pack 的 Preview Bridge 一样。先运行一次才会出预览。 |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | 用 **trimap** 收紧遮罩。**edge_erode** 把确定的前景从遮罩边缘往里收，**edge_dilate** 决定未知带向外延伸多远。只有这条带由 **method** 来判定（**vitmatte** 适合头发和细节，**guided_filter** 追求速度，或 **none**），所以带越窄，遮罩越紧。另有 **grow**（负值为收缩）、**fix_gap**、**black_point** / **white_point**、**feather**，以及 **edge_color_spread**，用来去掉抠图上的背景光晕。把遮罩（比如头发）接到 **detail_region**，就能只给那块区域更宽的 trimap（**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**）。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**trimap**。节点上有前后对比滑动，和 LC123 的预览一样：悬停时“之后”的图像在指针左边。**preview_view** 可在 cutout、mask 和 trimap 之间切换。先运行一次才会出预览。💡 先用 10 / 10，然后把两个值都往 3 收，得到紧致的边缘。**微调：** 所有像素值（**grow**、**fix_gap**、**edge_erode**、**edge_dilate**、各个 **detail_** 项、**feather**）都支持 0.1 px 步进的小数，点的步进是 0.001，边缘是真正的圆形而不是方块。滑块要以 **FLOAT** 接入（INT 插槽接不上）。⚠️ 数值都是真实像素。 |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | 用 BiRefNet 模型抠出主体。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask** 和 **on_background**（纯色底上的主体）。可选 **refine**（guided_filter 或 vitmatte），trimap 控制相同（**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**），另有 **grow**、**black_point** / **white_point** 和 **feather**。节点上没有预览（想要的话后面接一个 LC Mask Refine）。使用 ComfyUI 内置的背景移除加载器，所以没有额外依赖。💡 提高 **black_point** 可以清掉淡淡的雾边，头发用 **vitmatte**。 |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | 把图层放到背景上并混合。有 **x_percent** / **y_percent**（0.01 步进）、**scale**、**aspect_ratio**、**rotate**、**mirror** 和 29 种混合模式，**opacity** 以 0.1 步进，还有可选的 **layer_mask**（与图层自身的 alpha 相乘）。**background_image** 可选：不接的话，图层会放到与图层同尺寸的透明画布上（输出 RGBA，和 LayerStyle 的 V3 一样）。**transform_method**：lanczos、bicubic、bilinear、nearest。输出 **image** 和 **mask**（图层落下的位置）。纯 torch，没有额外依赖。 |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | 通过描述来选取对象：输入 **hair, eyes, bikini**，每个词都会被找出来并合并。**engine**：**grounding_dino + sam**（GroundingDINO 找框，SAM 出遮罩）或 **sam3**（SAM 3 一手包办，使用 ComfyUI 内置的 SAM 3 支持）。之后是与 Mask Refine 相同的精修（**refine**、**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**、**black_point** / **white_point**），节点上带前后对比滑动。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**raw_mask**。💡 sam3 的 **sam3_threshold** 从 0.5 开始比较合适；接近 0.3 时，它会对图里根本没有的词也瞎编出匹配。 |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | 选取人物的各个部分：**face**、**hair**、**body**、**clothes**、**accessories**、**background**，合并成一张遮罩。**engine**：**segformer**（分辨率更高，body 只包括手臂和腿）或 **mediapipe**（body 包括躯干和脖子的皮肤）。之后是与 Mask Refine 相同的精修。节点上没有预览（想要的话后面接一个 LC Mask Refine）。输出 **cutout**（RGBA）、**mask**、**raw_mask**。💡 做皮肤处理时，同时启用 **face** 和 **body**。 |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | 一键自动色阶。**mode**：**RGB**（每个通道各自处理，同时去除色偏）、**lum + sat**、**luminance**、**saturation** 或 **mono**。之后有 **red** / **green** / **blue** 平衡、**brightness**、**contrast**、**saturation** 微调，以及用来向原图回混的 **strength**。全部 0.1 步进。可选的 **mask** 同时限制测量色阶的位置和应用结果的位置（没接遮罩时，alpha 通道会当作遮罩使用）。纯 torch，没有额外依赖。 |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | 从单张图像生成深度图，每张图归一化到 0-1，除非开启 **invert**，否则 **越亮 = 越近**。读取原版 Depth Anything V2 权重，所以你已经放在 `models/depthanything` 里的副本可以直接用（也能找到 comfyui_controlnet_aux 里的）。输出 **depth**（3 通道图像）和 **depth_mask**。**resolution** 以 14 为步长。与 comfyui_controlnet_aux 的 Depth Anything V2 一致（相关系数 1.000）。模型代码已内置，无需额外安装包。 |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | 用 BAE 网络生成表面法线图（RGB = XYZ），风格与 ControlNet 的 normal_bae 相同。有 **resolution**，以及用于区分 OpenGL 与 DirectX 的 **flip_y**。与 comfyui_controlnet_aux 的 BAE 一致（相关系数 0.9999）。需要 `timm` 包（缺少时安装器会自动补上）。💡 这两张图正是 LC123 里 LC Lighting Control 的 **depth_map** 和 **normal_map** 所需要的。 |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | 按指定格式裁剪，并把人脸摆在合适的位置，而不是盲目居中裁：渲一次，适配所有社交平台格式，谁的头都不会被切掉。**aspect_ratio** 使用与 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier 相同的预设（或 **custom**）。**framing**：**widest** 在格式允许的范围内尽量多保留画面；**upper body**、**head & shoulders** 和 **face** 则根据人脸大小框得更紧（用于角色数据集）。**faces**：**all** 把每张脸都留在裁剪内，**largest** 只框主要的那张（海报或背景路人被误检时用它）。**output_size**：**preset size**（例如 1080x1350）或 **keep pixels**。由 SAM 3 找脸；接入 **mask** 可以框其他东西（汽车、产品、宠物）。什么都没找到：居中裁剪，控制台会提示 |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | 在节点上拖动来旋转、裁剪和扩边。圆形手柄用来旋转（按住 **Shift** 以 15° 步进，或直接输入 **angle**），框上的方形手柄用来扩边（向外拖）或裁剪（向内拖），在框内拖动则移动图像。**control_mask** 在模型需要绘制的地方是白色：即扩边部分以及旋转后露出的四角，所以可以直接接到 **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**。**fit**：**expand** 让框一开始就包住整个旋转后的图像，**crop** 则取没有空角的最大框。**fill**：**gray**（Krea 2 和 AnyPaint 期望的）、**edge**（拉伸最外层像素）、**white**、**black**。**aspect** 锁定输出形状，**snap_to** 向上取整尺寸。直角和 90 度倍数的旋转只复制像素，不重采样。**block**：**until turned or framed** 在图像还没动过时于此节点之后停止运行，所以第一次运行只是把图放到节点上；**never** 则始终放行。**keep_frame**：**keep (same image)** 让旋转和框在多次运行间保持不变（对同一张图做后期处理），**snap back after run** 在每次运行结束后重置，让下一张图从干净状态开始。先运行一次才能在节点上看到图像。 |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | 用 yijunwang2 的 **AnyPaint LoRA** 做 Krea 2 的 inpaint 和 outpaint（[这里](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint)，放进你的 loras 文件夹），按训练时的方式运行。遮罩之外的一切都原样返回。模型在绘制时会看到整张图的小副本，所以新内容能匹配光线和场景，遮罩周围还有一圈细边会被重画，接缝因此消失。**prompt**：描述整张完成后的图，而不只是改动的部分。**crop_to_mask** 做 inpaint 时开启（该区域在自己的裁剪里以 **inpaint_resolution** 重画），做 outpaint 时关闭。**composite**：**keep original** 只贴回绘制的区域，**raw** 是整张重画。用 Krea 2 Turbo，8 步，euler / simple，cfg 1。💡 “Remove the car” 会留下一团平的色块：请描述那里应该出现什么。 |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | 针对 **Z-Image**（Turbo / Base）的同款 inpaint 和 outpaint：同样的裁剪、保留、边框和接缝修复，由阿里的 **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** 在 inpaint 模式下绘制（[这里](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1)，放进 models/model_patches；8steps 那个版本用于 Turbo）。与 Krea 2 节点唯一的区别是最上面两个控件：**control**（union patch）和 **control_strength**。提示词里描述整张完成后的图。 |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | 适用于任何 **SDXL** checkpoint（SDXL、Pony、Illustrious、你自己的微调）的同款 inpaint 和 outpaint，不需要 LoRA。由 xinsir 的 **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** 在 repaint 模式下绘制（[这里](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0)，把 promax 文件放进 models/controlnet）。**prompt**：描述遮罩里要出现的东西，写短一点（“a red bucket full of fish on the pier”）。要移除东西，就描述那里应该有什么，或者留空，它会根据遮罩周围的画面填充（outpaint 仍然需要描述场景）。SDXL 使用真正的 **negative** 和 **cfg**（25 步，cfg 5，dpmpp_2m / karras）。**fooocus_inpaint**（可选，默认关闭）：lllyasviel 的 Fooocus inpaint patch（[这里](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint)，放 models/inpaint，需要 Acly 的 **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**）在 outpaint 和填充时融合得最好，但它更偏向重建原有内容，而不是添加新内容。⚠️ 两者都开时，把 **control_strength** 降到约 0.5：Pony 和 Illustrious 在 1 时会变成噪点。⚠️ **Outpaint：control_strength 约 0.2。** 到 1 时，旧图的直边会被当成真实的边缘，SDXL 就会沿着它画出窗框、栅栏或一条线。Inpaint 保持 1（遮罩被你的图像包围，所以能通过这个洞守住光线和边缘）。💡 用一个布尔值和两个浮点数接到 **control_strength**，就能跟着你的 inpaint / outpaint 开关切换。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | 用一个节点取代 SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer 那一整条链。用 SAM 3 找出你输入的内容（**hands, face, eyes**），并以完整细节重画。每只手或每张脸都有自己的裁剪，缩放到约 **inpaint_resolution** 的平方像素，重画后再混合回去。重画范围会稍微超出粘贴区域，并且沿接缝把颜色匹配到原图，所以边缘不会露出来。**tone_match**（开启）：重画区域在粘贴处会找回原图的亮度、对比度和颜色，同时保留新的细节（轻度重画否则会变得平淡发闷）；如果重画本来就是要改变颜色，就关掉它。改 denoise、steps 或 feather 会直接重画，不用再次搜索。**grow** / **feather** 调整遮罩形状，**padding** 是每个裁剪周围的上下文，**blend** 把原图混回来（1 = 全部用重画）。支持 4-D 和 5-D latent（SDXL、Flux、Krea 2、Anima、Qwen 等）。cfg 1 的模型把 **negative** 留空，SDXL 则要接上。什么都没找到？图像原样通过，节点会告诉你。节点上有前后对比滑动，并框出找到的区域。**LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** 从 LC pipe 取图像、模型、VAE 和采样设置；往里接 **image**、**model** 或 **vae** 就会改用你接的那个（比如没经过 pipe 的节点改过图、带了 LoRA 的模型，或者换了一个不同的模型）。它把结果放回 pipe 的图像里，并给后面的节点留下两样东西：所有细化器重画过的区域（会合并，所以脸 + 手 + 眼睛会叠加起来），由 **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** 带到新尺寸（即它的 **protected** 输出），以及 SAM 3 找到的内容，这样同一个词永远不会被搜两次。这两样都绑定在它们生成时对应的图像上，中间图像一变就会被忽略。💡 脸：denoise 0.3，blend 0.8。**cfg** 在两个版本里默认都是 1（pipe 版不再沿用主采样器的 cfg_1，那会让重画过于剧烈）。1 适用于 Krea 2、Flux、Z-Image，细化器 denoise 在约 0.4 以内时 SDXL 也适用（测过 cfg 1 到 7：结果一样）。它永远不会低于 1：低于 1 重画会出现斑点。💡 如果你的 positive 描述的是整个场景，就往 **inpaint_positive** 接一条针对该区域的短提示词（例如 “close-up of a woman's face, natural skin”）。否则在 denoise 0.3 及以上时，整个场景可能会被画进每一个裁剪里。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | 保留细化器成果的放大。VOSR 2.0（一步完成，内置，不需要其他包）会对输入的图像做锐化并添加细节，而不是用你的模型重画，所以脸和手保持细化器处理后的样子，不会出现新的皮肤斑块。请在细化器**之后**运行：渲染 → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**。**upscale_by** 1.5x、2x、3x 或 4x 一次完成，6x（3x + 2x）和 8x（4x + 2x）分两次（一次大放大会把皮肤打碎成块），**color_alignment** wavelet 保持颜色，**tile_size** 512（训练时的尺寸），**vae_tile_size** 越低越省 VRAM。**LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** 从 LC pipe 取图（即细化器留在里面的结果）并把结果放回去，紧跟在 **LC Smart Detailer (pipe)** 后面连一根线即可。它的 **protected** 输出是细化器区域在新尺寸下的版本：接到 LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale 的 **protect_mask**，它们就不会在细化器的成果上再叠加皮肤细节（普通版把 LC Smart Detailer 的 **mask** 当作 **protect_mask**，效果相同）。1 MP 图像放大 2x：在 RTX 5090 上约 5 秒，占用不到 7 GB。权重首次运行时下载（约 6.5 GB）。 |

## 模型与许可

- ✋ 模型**从不打包或再分发**。依赖模型的节点会在你第一次使用时从原始来源下载，或者复用你已有的副本。
- 下拉框里的每个模型都标注了它的许可证，所以你能看到自己选的是什么。
- **VITMatte**（LC Mask Refine）：`vitmatte-small-composition-1k` 和 `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`，均为 Apache-2.0。保存在 `models/vitmatte`。你在 `models/vitmatte` 里已有的副本会被自动识别。
- **BiRefNet**（LC Remove Background）：general、matting、portrait 和 HR 2048 几个变体，均为 MIT。保存在 `models/background_removal`，也就是 ComfyUI 自带加载器读取的同一个文件夹。
- **RMBG-2.0**（BRIA）：如果你已经把它放在 `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0` 里就会使用。不会替你下载。⚠️ 非商用许可。
- 较旧的 BiRefNet `.pth` 文件（如 `BiRefNet-ep480.pth`）使用 ComfyUI 无法加载的旧结构，所以不会列出。
- **GroundingDINO + SAM**（LC Segment Anything）：`grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base` 和 `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`，均为 Apache-2.0，Hugging Face 格式。保存在 `models/grounding-dino` 和 `models/sam`。你放在那里的原始格式 `.pth` 文件不会被使用（结构不同）。
- **SAM 3**（LC Segment Anything，sam3 引擎）：Meta 的原版 `facebook/sam3` 是受限的（需要人工审批），所以永远不会替你下载。你自己放在 `models/sam3`（或 ComfyUI 的 `models/detection`）里的 `sam3.safetensors` 会被识别。想要一键方案的话，下拉框提供来自 `Comfy-Org/sam3.1` 的 **SAM 3.1**（`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`，1.7 GB），这是 ComfyUI 自己的 SAM 3 模板所用的同一份无需审批的副本，保存到 `models/sam3`。适用 SAM License 条款（Hugging Face 将其列为 *other*）。
- **Segformer clothes**（LC Person Mask）：`mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`，保存在 `models/segformer_b2_clothes`。⚠️ 它的 Hugging Face 卡片写的许可证是 *other*，且基于 NVIDIA 的 SegFormer，所以在你确认之前，请当作**未获商用许可**。
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass**（LC Person Mask）：Google 的 `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`，保存在 `models/mediapipe`。条款请查看它的模型卡。此包不会安装 `mediapipe` Python 包。
- **Depth Anything V2**（LC Depth Anything V2）：**Small 是 Apache-2.0**，**Base / Large / Giant 是 CC-BY-NC-4.0（非商用）**。保存在 `models/depthanything`。Small 排在最前面，所以它是默认值。
- **BAE normals**（LC Normal Map）：来自 lllyasviel/Annotators 的 `scannet.pt`，保存在 `models/normalbae`。⚠️ 在 ScanNet 上训练，Hugging Face 卡片只写了 *other*。在你确认之前，请当作**未获商用许可**。
- ⚠️ 有些模型是**非商用**的，标签会告诉你。商用前检查许可证是你自己的责任。

## ノード

| ノード | 機能 |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | ノード上でキャンバスの端を外側にドラッグします。元画像の内側をドラッグすると位置を変えられます。**free**、または一般的なアスペクト比に固定、グレーで塗りつぶし。**control_image**、**control_mask**(白 = 新しい領域)、**mask_image**、**width**、**height** を出力します。**hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** は実行のたびにボックスを画像に戻し、画像をそのまま通します(新しい画像は必ずきれいな状態から始まります)。**held** は設定したキャンバスを保持し、それごと画像を通します。**block** を **if_empty_mask** にすると、マスクが空のとき下流のすべてを止めます: snap_to_imageなら毎回(端をドラッグで広げ、heldに切り替えて、もう一度実行)、heldなら端を引き出していないときだけです。プレビューを出すには一度実行してください。*注:* **snap_to** は最終サイズを倍数(デフォルトは8)に切り上げます。1にするとオフになります。 |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | ノード上で直接マスクを描きます。クリックでポイントを追加(数の制限なし)、ドラッグで移動、shift+クリックで1つ削除。トグルを **pencil** に切り替えるとフリーハンドになります。**smooth**、**invert**、**feather**、**opacity** は標準装備。ノード上にUndoとClearボタンがあります。一番上のウィジェット **block** を **if_empty_mask** にすると、何か描くまで下流のすべてを止めます。Impact PackのPreview Bridgeと同じ考え方です。プレビューを出すには一度実行してください。 |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | **trimap** でマスクを引き締めます。**edge_erode** は確実な前景をマスクの縁から内側に引き込み、**edge_dilate** は不確定な帯がどこまで外に広がるかを決めます。その帯だけが **method**(髪や細部には **vitmatte**、速度重視なら **guided_filter**、または **none**)で判定されるので、帯が狭いほどマスクはタイトになります。ほかに **grow**(マイナスで縮小)、**fix_gap**、**black_point** / **white_point**、**feather**、切り抜きの背景ハローを消す **edge_color_spread** があります。**detail_region**(髪など)にマスクを接続すると、その領域だけtrimapを広げられます(**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**)。**cutout**(RGBA)、**mask**、**trimap** を出力します。LC123のプレビューと同じ、ノード上のbefore/afterワイプ付き: ホバーするとポインターの左側にafter画像が出ます。**preview_view** で cutout、mask、trimap を切り替えます。プレビューを出すには一度実行してください。💡 まず10 / 10から始めて、両方を3に向けて縮めると縁がタイトになります。**マイクロ調整:** すべてのピクセル値(**grow**、**fix_gap**、**edge_erode**、**edge_dilate**、**detail_** 系、**feather**)は0.1px刻みの小数が使え、ポイントは0.001刻み、縁はブロックではなく真円です。スライダーは **FLOAT** として接続してください(INTソケットは接続できません)。⚠️ 数値は実際のピクセルです。 |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | BiRefNetモデルで被写体を切り抜きます。**cutout**(RGBA)、**mask**、**on_background**(単色背景上の被写体)を出力します。任意の **refine**(guided_filterかvitmatte)は、同じtrimapコントロール(**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**)に加えて、**grow**、**black_point** / **white_point**、**feather** も使えます。ノード上のプレビューはありません(必要なら後ろにLC Mask Refineを追加してください)。ComfyUI内蔵のbackground-removal loaderを使うので、追加の依存関係はありません。💡 かすかなもやを消すには **black_point** を上げ、髪には **vitmatte** を使います。 |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | 背景の上にレイヤーを置いてブレンドします。**x_percent** / **y_percent**(0.01刻み)、**scale**、**aspect_ratio**、**rotate**、**mirror**、29種類のブレンドモード、0.1刻みの **opacity**、任意の **layer_mask**(レイヤー自身のアルファと乗算)。**background_image** は任意: 接続しなければ、レイヤーと同じサイズの透明キャンバスに置かれます(LayerStyleのV3と同じRGBA出力)。**transform_method**: lanczos、bicubic、bilinear、nearest。**image** と **mask**(レイヤーが乗った場所)を出力します。純粋なtorchで、追加の依存関係はありません。 |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | 言葉で説明して選択します: **hair, eyes, bikini** と入力すると、それぞれの単語が見つかって合成されます。**engine**: **grounding_dino + sam**(GroundingDINOがボックスを見つけ、SAMがマスクを作る)または **sam3**(SAM 3が両方をこなす。ComfyUI内蔵のSAM 3対応を使用)。その後、Mask Refineと同じrefine(**refine**、**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**、**black_point** / **white_point**)とノード上のbefore/afterワイプがあります。**cutout**(RGBA)、**mask**、**raw_mask** を出力します。💡 sam3では **sam3_threshold** 0.5が良い出発点です。0.3付近だと、画像にない単語にもマッチをでっち上げます。 |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | 人物のパーツを選びます: **face**、**hair**、**body**、**clothes**、**accessories**、**background**。選んだものが1つのマスクに合成されます。**engine**: **segformer**(高解像度。bodyは腕と脚のみ)または **mediapipe**(bodyに胴体と首の肌を含む)。その後、Mask Refineと同じrefine。ノード上のプレビューはありません(必要なら後ろにLC Mask Refineを追加してください)。**cutout**(RGBA)、**mask**、**raw_mask** を出力します。💡 肌の作業には、**face** と **body** を有効にします。 |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | ワンクリックのオートレベル。**mode**: **RGB**(各チャンネルを個別に処理し、色かぶりも除去)、**lum + sat**、**luminance**、**saturation**、**mono**。その後、**red** / **green** / **blue** バランス、**brightness**、**contrast**、**saturation** の微調整と、元に戻して混ぜる **strength**。すべて0.1刻み。任意の **mask** で、レベルを測定する場所と結果を適用する場所の両方を限定できます(接続しない場合はアルファチャンネルがマスクとして働きます)。純粋なtorchで、追加の依存関係はありません。 |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | 1枚の画像からデプスマップを作ります。画像ごとに0-1に正規化され、**invert** がオンでない限り **bright = near** です。オリジナルのDepth Anything V2の重みを読み込むので、`models/depthanything` に既にあるコピーが使えます(comfyui_controlnet_auxにあるものも見つけます)。**depth**(3チャンネル画像)と **depth_mask** を出力します。**resolution** は14刻み。comfyui_controlnet_auxのDepth Anything V2と一致します(相関1.000)。モデルコードは同梱しているので、追加パッケージは不要です。 |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | BAEネットワークによるサーフェスノーマルマップ(RGB = XYZ)。ControlNetのnormal_baeと同じスタイルです。**resolution** と、OpenGL対DirectX用の **flip_y** があります。comfyui_controlnet_auxのBAEと一致します(相関0.9999)。`timm` パッケージが必要です(なければインストーラーが追加します)。💡 どちらのマップも、LC123のLC Lighting Controlが **depth_map** と **normal_map** として求めるものです。 |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | 闇雲な中央クロップではなく、顔をうまく配置したフォーマットにクロップします: 1回のレンダリングで、あらゆるSNSフォーマットに対応し、誰の頭も切れません。**aspect_ratio** はLC Aspect Ratio Simplifierと同じプリセットを使います(または **custom**)。**framing**: **widest** はフォーマットが許す限り多くの絵を残し、**upper body**、**head & shoulders**、**face** は顔のサイズからよりタイトにフレーミングします(キャラクターのデータセット向け)。**faces**: **all** はすべての顔をクロップに収め、**largest** はメインの顔をフレーミングします(ポスターや背景の人が拾われるときに使います)。**output_size**: **preset size**(例: 1080x1350)または **keep pixels**。SAM 3が顔を見つけます。ほかのもの(車、商品、ペット)をフレーミングするには **mask** を接続してください。何も見つからないときは中央クロップになり、コンソールにそう表示されます |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | ノード上でドラッグして、画像を回転、クロップ、パディングします。丸いハンドルで回転(**Shift** を押しながらで15°刻み、または **angle** を入力)、フレームの四角いハンドルでパディング(外にドラッグ)またはクロップ(内にドラッグ)、フレームの内側をドラッグすると画像が動きます。**control_mask** は、モデルが描く必要のある場所が白になります: パディングと、回転で現れる角の部分です。そのまま **LC Krea2 AnyPaint** に接続できます。**fit**: **expand** は回転した画像全体を囲むフレームから始め、**crop** は空の角がない最大のボックスから始めます。**fill**: **gray**(Krea 2とAnyPaintが期待するもの)、**edge**(外側のピクセルを引き伸ばす)、**white**、**black**。**aspect** は出力の形を固定し、**snap_to** はサイズを切り上げます。まっすぐな回転と90度回転はピクセルをコピーするだけで、リサンプルしません。**block**: **until turned or framed** は、画像に手が加えられていない間、このノードの後で実行を止めるので、最初の実行ではノードに画像が置かれるだけです。**never** は常に通します。**keep_frame**: **keep (same image)** は回転とフレームを実行のたびに保持し(同じ画像のポストプロセス用)、**snap back after run** は実行が終わるたびにリセットして、次の画像をきれいな状態から始めます。画像をノード上に表示するには、一度実行してください。 |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | yijunwang2氏の **AnyPaint LoRA**([こちら](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint)、lorasフォルダに入れてください)で、学習されたとおりの方法で行うKrea 2のinpaintとoutpaint。マスクの外側は元のまま返ってきます。モデルは描いている間、絵全体の小さなコピーを見ているので、新しい部分は光やシーンに合い、マスクのまわりの細い縁も描き直されるので、継ぎ目は消えます。**prompt**: 変更部分だけでなく、完成した絵全体を説明してください。**crop_to_mask** はinpaintではオン(領域は自分のクロップ内で **inpaint_resolution** で描き直されます)、outpaintではオフ。**composite**: **keep original** は描いた領域だけを貼り戻し、**raw** は全体の描き直しです。Krea 2 Turbo、8 steps、euler / simple、cfg 1を使ってください。💡 "Remove the car"だとのっぺりした塊が残ります。代わりに、そこにあるべきものを説明してください。 |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | **Z-Image**(Turbo / Base)用の同じinpaintとoutpaint: 同じクロップ、保持、境界、継ぎ目の修正で、Alibabaの **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** がinpaintモードで描きます([こちら](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1)、models/model_patchesに入れてください。8stepsのものはTurbo用です)。Krea 2のノードとの違いは、一番上の2つのウィジェット **control**(unionパッチ)と **control_strength** だけです。プロンプトには完成した絵全体を説明してください。 |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | あらゆる **SDXL** チェックポイント(SDXL、Pony、Illustrious、自作のfinetune)用の同じinpaintとoutpaint。LoRAは不要です。xinsir氏の **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** をrepaintモードで使って描きます([こちら](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0)、promaxファイルをmodels/controlnetに入れてください)。**prompt**: マスクに入るものを短く説明します("a red bucket full of fish on the pier")。何かを消すには、そこにあるべきものを説明するか、空のままにするとマスク周りの絵から埋められます(outpaintではシーンの説明が必要です)。SDXLは本物の **negative** と **cfg** を使います(25 steps、cfg 5、dpmpp_2m / karras)。**fooocus_inpaint**(任意、デフォルトはオフ): lllyasviel氏のFooocus inpaintパッチ([こちら](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint)、models/inpaint、Acly氏の **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes** が必要)は、outpaintと塗りつぶしで最もなじみますが、追加するよりも元にあったものを作り直す傾向が強いです。⚠️ 両方オンの場合は、**control_strength** を約0.5に下げてください: PonyとIllustriousは1だとノイズになります。⚠️ **Outpaint: control_strength は約0.2。** 1だと元の絵のまっすぐな縁が本物の縁として読まれ、SDXLがそこに窓枠やフェンスや線を描いてしまいます。Inpaintは1のままです(マスクは絵に囲まれているので、穴を通して光と縁が保たれます)。💡 booleanと2つのfloatを **control_strength** に入れると、inpaint / outpaintのトグルと連動して切り替わります。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | SEGS / Impact FaceDetailerのチェーンを1つのノードに置き換えます。入力したもの(**hands, face, eyes**)をSAM 3で見つけて、フルディテールで描き直します。手や顔ごとに独自のクロップが作られ、約 **inpaint_resolution** の2乗ピクセルにスケールされ、描き直されて、元に戻されます。描き直しは貼り付けた範囲より少し外まで届き、継ぎ目に沿って色が元に合わされるので、縁は見えません。**tone_match**(オン): 描き直した部分に、貼り付けた場所の元の明るさ、コントラスト、色が戻りつつ、新しいディテールは保たれます(そうしないと、軽い描き直しは平坦でくすんで戻ってきます)。描き直しで色を変えたいときはオフにします。denoise、steps、featherを変えると、再検出せずに描き直します。**grow** / **feather** はマスクの形を、**padding** は各クロップ周りのコンテキストを、**blend** は元の絵をどれだけ混ぜ戻すかを決めます(1 = すべて描き直し)。4Dと5Dのlatent(SDXL、Flux、Krea 2、Anima、Qwenなど)で動きます。cfg 1のモデルでは **negative** を空にし、SDXLでは接続します。何も見つからない? 画像はそのまま通り、ノードがそう表示します。見つかった領域をアウトラインで示すbefore/afterワイプがノード上にあります。**LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** は、画像、モデル、VAE、samplerの設定をLC pipeから受け取ります。**image**、**model**、**vae** を接続すると、そちらが優先されます(pipeのない別のノードで画像が変わった場合、LoRA付きのモデル、または別のモデル)。結果はpipeのimageに戻され、後続のノード向けに2つのものが残ります: detailerが描き直したすべての領域(結合されるので、顔 + 手 + 目が加算されます)は **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** が新しいサイズに引き継ぎ(その **protected** 出力)、SAM 3が見つけたものは、同じ単語が二度検索されないようにします。どちらも作られた画像に紐づいており、途中で画像が変わった場合は無視されます。💡 顔: denoise 0.3、blend 0.8。**cfg** は両バージョンでデフォルト1です(pipe版はメインsamplerのcfg_1を使わなくなりました。それで描き直しが極端になっていたためです)。1はKrea 2、Flux、Z-Imageで、そしてdetailerのdenoiseが約0.4まででSDXLでも有効です(cfg 1から7でテスト済み: 同じ結果)。1未満には決してなりません: 1未満だと描き直しが斑点だらけになります。💡 positiveがシーン全体を説明している場合は、その領域用の短いプロンプトを **inpaint_positive** に接続してください(例: "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin")。そうしないと、denoise 0.3以上では、シーンがすべてのクロップに描き込まれることがあります。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | detailerの仕事を保つアップスケール。VOSR 2.0(1ステップ、内蔵、他のパック不要)は、渡された絵をモデルで描き直すのではなく、シャープにして細部を足すので、顔や手はdetailerが仕上げたまま通り、新しい肌のまだらも出ません。detailerの**後**に実行してください: render → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**。**upscale_by** は1.5x、2x、3x、4xを1パスで、6x(3x + 2x)と8x(4x + 2x)を2パスで(1回の大きなパスだと肌がパッチ状に崩れます)。**color_alignment** wavelet は色を保ち、**tile_size** 512(学習時のサイズ)、**vae_tile_size** は低いほどVRAMが少なくなります。**LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** は、LC pipeから画像(detailerが残したもの)を受け取り、結果を戻します。**LC Smart Detailer (pipe)** の1本後ろに置いてください。その **protected** 出力は、新しいサイズでのdetailerの領域です: LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale の **protect_mask** に接続すると、detailerの仕事の上に肌のディテールが重ねて足されることはありません(通常版は、LC Smart Detailerの **mask** を **protect_mask** として受け取り、同じ出力を返します)。1 MPの絵の2x: RTX 5090で約5秒、7 GB未満。重みは初回実行時にダウンロードされます(約6.5 GB)。 |

## モデルとライセンス

- ✋ モデルは**決して同梱も再配布もしません**。モデルを使うノードは、初めて使うときに元の配布元からダウンロードするか、既にあるコピーを再利用します。
- ドロップダウンの各モデルにはライセンスが表示されているので、何を選んでいるかがわかります。
- **VITMatte**(LC Mask Refine): `vitmatte-small-composition-1k` と `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`、どちらもApache-2.0。`models/vitmatte` に保存されます。`models/vitmatte` に既にあるコピーは自動的に使われます。
- **BiRefNet**(LC Remove Background): general、matting、portrait、HR 2048の各バリアント、すべてMIT。`models/background_removal` に保存されます。ComfyUI自身のローダーが読むのと同じフォルダです。
- **RMBG-2.0**(BRIA): `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0` に既にあれば使われます。ダウンロードはしません。⚠️ 非商用ライセンス。
- 古いBiRefNetの `.pth` ファイル(`BiRefNet-ep480.pth` など)は、ComfyUIが読み込めない古い形式なので、一覧には表示されません。
- **GroundingDINO + SAM**(LC Segment Anything): `grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base` と `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`、すべてApache-2.0、Hugging Face形式。`models/grounding-dino` と `models/sam` に保存されます。そこにあるオリジナル形式の `.pth` ファイルは(形式が違うため)使われません。
- **SAM 3**(LC Segment Anything、sam3エンジン): Metaのオリジナルの `facebook/sam3` はゲート付き(手動承認)なので、ダウンロードはしません。`models/sam3`(またはComfyUIの `models/detection`)にある自分の `sam3.safetensors` は使われます。ワンクリックの選択肢として、ドロップダウンには `Comfy-Org/sam3.1` の **SAM 3.1**(`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`、1.7 GB)があります。ComfyUI自身のSAM 3テンプレートが使うのと同じ、ゲートなしのコピーで、`models/sam3` に保存されます。SAMライセンスの条項が適用されます(Hugging Faceでは*other*と表示)。
- **Segformer clothes**(LC Person Mask): `mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`、`models/segformer_b2_clothes` に保存されます。⚠️ Hugging Faceのカードではライセンスが*other*で、NVIDIAのSegFormerをベースにしているので、確認するまでは**商用利用は許可されていない**ものとして扱ってください。
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass**(LC Person Mask): Googleの `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`、`models/mediapipe` に保存されます。条項はモデルカードで確認してください。`mediapipe` Pythonパッケージは、このパックではインストールされません。
- **Depth Anything V2**(LC Depth Anything V2): **SmallはApache-2.0**、**Base / Large / GiantはCC-BY-NC-4.0(非商用)**。`models/depthanything` に保存されます。Smallが先頭に表示されるので、デフォルトになります。
- **BAE normals**(LC Normal Map): lllyasviel/Annotatorsの `scannet.pt`、`models/normalbae` に保存されます。⚠️ ScanNetで学習されており、Hugging Faceのカードには*other*としか書かれていません。確認するまでは**商用利用は許可されていない**ものとして扱ってください。
- ⚠️ 一部のモデルは**非商用**です。ラベルでわかります。商用利用の前にライセンスを確認するのは、あなたの責任です。

| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer 체인을 노드 하나로 대체합니다. 입력한 대상(**hands, face, eyes**)을 SAM 3로 찾아 풀 디테일로 다시 그립니다. 손이나 얼굴마다 각자의 크롭을 **inpaint_resolution** 제곱 픽셀 정도로 스케일해 다시 그리고 되붙입니다. 재생성은 붙이는 영역보다 조금 더 넓게 퍼지고 이음새를 따라 색을 원본에 맞추기 때문에 경계가 보이지 않습니다. **tone_match**(켜짐): 재생성이 붙는 곳에서 원본의 밝기, 대비, 색을 되찾고 새 디테일은 유지합니다(약한 재생성은 그렇지 않으면 밋밋하고 칙칙해짐). 재생성으로 색을 바꾸려는 경우에는 끄세요. denoise, steps, feather를 바꾸면 다시 찾지 않고 재생성합니다. **grow** / **feather**는 마스크를 다듬고, **padding**은 각 크롭 주변의 컨텍스트이며, **blend**는 원본을 섞어 넣습니다(1 = 전부 재생성). 4-D와 5-D latent(SDXL, Flux, Krea 2, Anima, Qwen 등)에서 동작합니다. cfg 1 모델은 **negative**를 비우고 SDXL은 연결하세요. 아무것도 못 찾으면 이미지는 그대로 통과하고 노드가 알려 줍니다. 노드에는 찾은 영역을 윤곽선으로 표시하는 전/후 와이프가 있습니다. **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹**는 LC 파이프에서 이미지, model, VAE, sampler 설정을 가져옵니다. 대신 쓰고 싶으면 **image**, **model**, **vae**를 직접 연결하세요(파이프 없는 노드가 그림을 바꾼 경우, LoRA가 걸린 모델, 다른 모델). 결과는 파이프의 image에 되돌려 넣고, 뒤따르는 노드를 위해 두 가지를 남깁니다. 하나는 detailer들이 다시 그린 모든 영역(합쳐져서 face + hands + eyes가 더해짐)으로, **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)**가 새 크기로 옮겨 줍니다(**protected** 출력). 다른 하나는 SAM 3가 찾은 것으로, 같은 단어를 두 번 검색하지 않게 합니다. 둘 다 만들어진 그림에 묶여 있으며 그 사이에 그림이 바뀌면 무시됩니다. 💡 얼굴: denoise 0.3, blend 0.8. **cfg**는 두 버전 모두 기본 1입니다(pipe 버전은 더 이상 메인 sampler의 cfg_1을 가져오지 않습니다. 그 때문에 재생성이 과격했습니다). 1은 Krea 2, Flux, Z-Image에 통하고, detailer denoise 0.4 정도까지는 SDXL에도 통합니다(cfg 1~7로 테스트: 결과 동일). 1 아래로는 내려가지 않습니다. 1 미만이면 재생성에 얼룩이 생깁니다. 💡 positive가 장면 전체를 묘사한다면, 해당 영역용 짧은 프롬프트를 **inpaint_positive**에 연결하세요(예: "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin"). 그렇지 않으면 denoise 0.3 이상에서 장면이 모든 크롭에 그려질 수 있습니다. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | detailer들의 작업을 그대로 살리는 업스케일입니다. VOSR 2.0(원스텝, 내장, 다른 팩 불필요)은 모델로 다시 그리는 대신 받은 그림을 선명하게 하고 미세한 디테일을 더합니다. 그래서 얼굴과 손이 detailer가 남긴 그대로 나오고 새로운 피부 얼룩도 생기지 않습니다. detailer **뒤에** 실행하세요: render → **LC Smart Detailer** → **LC VOSR2 Upscale**. **upscale_by**는 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x는 한 번에, 6x(3x + 2x)와 8x(4x + 2x)는 두 번에 합니다(한 번에 크게 하면 피부가 얼룩덜룩해짐). **color_alignment** wavelet은 색을 유지하고, **tile_size** 512(학습된 크기), **vae_tile_size**는 낮을수록 VRAM을 덜 씁니다. **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩**는 LC 파이프에서 그림(detailer가 남긴 것)을 가져와 결과를 되돌려 넣으며, **LC Smart Detailer (pipe)** 바로 뒤에 선 하나로 연결됩니다. **protected** 출력은 새 크기로 옮긴 detailer 영역입니다. LC Skin Texture / LC Skin Upscale의 **protect_mask**에 연결하면 detailer 작업 위에 피부 디테일을 덧입히지 않습니다(일반 버전은 LC Smart Detailer의 **mask**를 **protect_mask**로 받아 같은 출력을 냅니다). 1 MP 그림 2x: RTX 5090에서 약 5초, 7 GB 미만. 가중치는 첫 실행 때 다운로드됩니다(약 6.5 GB). |

---

## 모델과 라이선스

- ✋ 모델은 **절대 번들하거나 재배포하지 않습니다**. 모델 기반 노드는 처음 사용할 때 원 출처에서 다운로드하거나, 이미 가진 사본을 재사용합니다.
- 드롭다운의 각 모델에는 라이선스가 표시되어 있어서 무엇을 고르는지 알 수 있습니다.
- **VITMatte**(LC Mask Refine): `vitmatte-small-composition-1k`와 `vitmatte-base-composition-1k`, 둘 다 Apache-2.0. `models/vitmatte` 아래에 저장됩니다. `models/vitmatte`에 이미 있는 사본은 자동으로 인식합니다.
- **BiRefNet**(LC Remove Background): general, matting, portrait, HR 2048 변형, 모두 MIT. ComfyUI 자체 로더가 읽는 폴더와 같은 `models/background_removal` 아래에 저장됩니다.
- **RMBG-2.0**(BRIA): `models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0`에 이미 있으면 사용합니다. 대신 다운로드해 주지는 않습니다. ⚠️ 비상업 라이선스.
- 예전 BiRefNet `.pth` 파일(예: `BiRefNet-ep480.pth`)은 ComfyUI가 불러올 수 없는 구형 구조여서 목록에 나타나지 않습니다.
- **GroundingDINO + SAM**(LC Segment Anything): `grounding-dino-tiny` / `-base`와 `sam-vit-base` / `-large` / `-huge`, 모두 Apache-2.0, Hugging Face 형식. `models/grounding-dino`와 `models/sam` 아래에 저장됩니다. 거기에 있는 원본 형식 `.pth` 파일은 구조가 달라 쓰이지 않습니다.
- **SAM 3**(LC Segment Anything, sam3 engine): Meta 원본 `facebook/sam3`는 게이트(수동 승인)가 걸려 있어서 대신 다운로드해 주지 않습니다. `models/sam3`(또는 ComfyUI의 `models/detection`)에 있는 직접 받은 `sam3.safetensors`는 인식합니다. 원클릭 옵션으로는 드롭다운에서 `Comfy-Org/sam3.1`의 **SAM 3.1**(`sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors`, 1.7 GB)을 고를 수 있습니다. ComfyUI 자체 SAM 3 템플릿이 쓰는 것과 같은 게이트 없는 사본이며 `models/sam3`에 저장됩니다. SAM 라이선스 조건이 적용됩니다(Hugging Face에는 *other*로 표시).
- **Segformer clothes**(LC Person Mask): `mattmdjaga/segformer_b2_clothes`, `models/segformer_b2_clothes` 아래에 저장됩니다. ⚠️ Hugging Face 카드에 라이선스가 *other*로 되어 있고 NVIDIA SegFormer 기반이므로, 직접 확인하기 전까지는 **상업적 사용이 승인되지 않은 것**으로 취급하세요.
- **MediaPipe selfie multiclass**(LC Person Mask): Google의 `selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite`, `models/mediapipe` 아래에 저장됩니다. 약관은 모델 카드를 확인하세요. `mediapipe` Python 패키지는 이 팩이 설치하지 않습니다.
- **Depth Anything V2**(LC Depth Anything V2): **Small은 Apache-2.0**, **Base / Large / Giant는 CC-BY-NC-4.0(비상업)**. `models/depthanything` 아래에 저장됩니다. Small이 맨 위에 있어서 기본값입니다.
- **BAE normals**(LC Normal Map): lllyasviel/Annotators의 `scannet.pt`, `models/normalbae` 아래에 저장됩니다. ⚠️ ScanNet으로 학습되었고 Hugging Face 카드에는 *other*라고만 되어 있습니다. 직접 확인하기 전까지는 **상업적 사용이 승인되지 않은 것**으로 취급하세요.
- ⚠️ 일부 모델은 **비상업용**입니다. 라벨에 표시되어 있습니다. 상업적으로 쓰기 전에 라이선스를 확인하는 것은 본인의 몫입니다.

## Nodes

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node. Drag inside the source to reposition it. **free** or locked to a common aspect ratio, grey fill. Outputs **control_image**, **control_mask** (white = new area), **mask_image**, **width**, **height**. **hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** puts the box back on the image every run and passes the image through as is (so a new image always starts clean); **held** keeps the canvas you set up and passes the image through with it. **block** set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream when the mask is empty: with snap_to_image that means every run (drag the edges out, switch to held, run again), with held only if you have not pulled an edge out. Run once to get the preview. *note:* **snap_to** rounds the final size up to a multiple (8 by default), set it to 1 to turn that off. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draw a mask right on the node. Click to add points (no limit), drag to move, shift+click removes one. Flip the toggle to **pencil** for freehand. **smooth**, **invert**, **feather**, and **opacity** are built in. Undo and Clear buttons on the node. **block** (top widget) set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream until you have drawn something, same idea as Impact Pack's Preview Bridge. Run once to get the preview. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tighten a mask with a **trimap**. **edge_erode** pulls the sure-foreground in from the mask edge, **edge_dilate** sets how far the unknown band reaches out. Only that band is decided by the **method** (**vitmatte** for hair and fine detail, **guided_filter** for speed, or **none**), so a narrower band means a tighter mask. Also **grow** (negative shrinks), **fix_gap**, **black_point** / **white_point**, **feather**, and **edge_color_spread** to cut background halos on the cutout. Plug a mask into **detail_region** (like hair) to give just that area a wider trimap (**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **trimap**. Before/after wipe on the node, same as the LC123 previews: hover and the after image sits left of the pointer. **preview_view** switches between cutout, mask and trimap. Run once to get the preview. 💡 Start with 10 / 10, then shrink both toward 3 for a tight edge. **Micro adjust:** every pixel value (**grow**, **fix_gap**, **edge_erode**, **edge_dilate**, the **detail_** ones, **feather**) takes decimals in 0.1 px steps, the points step by 0.001, and the edges are true circles, not blocks. Wire sliders in as **FLOAT** (INT sockets will not plug into these). ⚠️ Numbers are real pixels. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Cut the subject out with a BiRefNet model. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, and **on_background** (subject on a solid color). Optional **refine** (guided_filter or vitmatte) with the same trimap controls (**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**), plus **grow**, **black_point** / **white_point**, and **feather**. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Uses ComfyUI's built-in background-removal loader, so no extra dependency. 💡 Raise **black_point** to clear faint haze, use **vitmatte** for hair. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Place a layer on a background and blend it. **x_percent** / **y_percent** (0.01 steps), **scale**, **aspect_ratio**, **rotate**, **mirror**, and 29 blend modes, with **opacity** in 0.1 steps and an optional **layer_mask** (multiplied with the layer's own alpha). **background_image** is optional: leave it off and the layer goes on a transparent canvas the size of the layer (RGBA out, like LayerStyle's V3). **transform_method**: lanczos, bicubic, bilinear, nearest. Outputs **image** and **mask** (where the layer landed). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Select things by describing them: type **hair, eyes, bikini** and each word is found and combined. **engine**: **grounding_dino + sam** (GroundingDINO finds boxes, SAM makes masks) or **sam3** (SAM 3 does both, using ComfyUI's built-in SAM 3 support). Then the same refine as Mask Refine (**refine**, **edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**, **black_point** / **white_point**) and a before/after wipe on the node. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For sam3, **sam3_threshold** 0.5 is a good start; near 0.3 it invents matches for words that are not in the image. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Pick the parts of a person: **face**, **hair**, **body**, **clothes**, **accessories**, **background**, combined into one mask. **engine**: **segformer** (higher resolution, body is arms and legs only) or **mediapipe** (body includes torso and neck skin). Then the same refine as Mask Refine. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For skin work, enable **face** and **body**. |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels. **mode**: **RGB** (each channel on its own, also removes color casts), **lum + sat**, **luminance**, **saturation**, or **mono**. Then **red** / **green** / **blue** balance, **brightness**, **contrast**, **saturation** trims, and **strength** to blend back toward the original. All in 0.1 steps. An optional **mask** limits both where the levels are measured and where the result is applied (an alpha channel works as the mask when none is connected). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth map from one image, normalized 0-1 per image, **bright = near** unless **invert** is on. Reads the original Depth Anything V2 weights, so a copy you already have in `models/depthanything` works (it also finds the ones in comfyui_controlnet_aux). Outputs **depth** (3-channel image) and **depth_mask**. **resolution** in steps of 14. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's Depth Anything V2 (correlation 1.000). Model code is vendored, no extra package. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Surface normal map (RGB = XYZ) with the BAE network, the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. **resolution**, and **flip_y** for OpenGL vs DirectX. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's BAE (correlation 0.9999). Needs the `timm` package (the installer adds it if missing). 💡 Both maps are what LC Lighting Control in LC123 wants as its **depth_map** and **normal_map**. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well, not a blind centre crop: one render, every social format, nobody's head cut off. **aspect_ratio** uses the same presets as LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (or **custom**). **framing**: **widest** keeps as much picture as the format allows; **upper body**, **head & shoulders** and **face** frame tighter from the face size (character datasets). **faces**: **all** keeps every face in the crop, **largest** frames the main one (use it when posters or background people get picked up). **output_size**: **preset size** (e.g. 1080x1350) or **keep pixels**. SAM 3 finds the faces; wire a **mask** to frame anything else (a car, a product, a pet). Nothing found: a centre crop, and the console says so |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. The round handle turns it (hold **Shift** for 15° steps, or type the **angle**), the frame's square handles pad (drag out) or crop (drag in), and dragging inside the frame moves the picture. The **control_mask** is white where the model has to paint: the padding and the corners a turn opens up, so it goes straight into **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**. **fit**: **expand** starts the frame around the whole turned picture, **crop** at the largest box with no empty corners. **fill**: **gray** (what Krea 2 and AnyPaint expect), **edge** (stretches the outer pixels), **white**, **black**. **aspect** locks the output shape, **snap_to** rounds the size up. Straight and quarter turns copy pixels, never resample. **block**: **until turned or framed** stops the run after this node while the picture is untouched, so the first run only puts the picture on the node; **never** always passes it on. **keep_frame**: **keep (same image)** holds the turn and frame run after run (post processing the same picture), **snap back after run** resets them once a run finishes so the next image starts clean. Run once to see the picture on the node. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with yijunwang2's **AnyPaint LoRA** ([Here](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint), put it in your loras folder), run the way it was trained. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. The model sees a small copy of the whole picture while it paints, so the new part matches the light and the scene, and a thin border around the mask is redrawn so the seam disappears. **prompt**: describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. **crop_to_mask** on for inpaint (the area is redrawn in its own crop at **inpaint_resolution**), off for outpaint. **composite**: **keep original** pastes back only the painted area, **raw** is the whole redraw. Use Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1. 💡 "Remove the car" leaves a flat blob: describe what should be there instead. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for **Z-Image** (Turbo / Base): the same crop, keep, border and seam fix, painted by Alibaba's **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** in inpaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1), put it in models/model_patches; the 8steps one is for Turbo). The only difference from the Krea 2 node is the top two widgets: **control** (the union patch) and **control_strength**. Describe the whole finished picture in the prompt. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any **SDXL** checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious, your finetunes), no LoRA needed. Painted by xinsir's **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** in repaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0), put the promax file in models/controlnet). **prompt**: describe what goes in the mask, short ("a red bucket full of fish on the pier"). To remove something, describe what should be there instead, or leave it empty and it fills from the picture around the mask (outpaint still wants the scene described). SDXL uses a real **negative** and **cfg** (25 steps, cfg 5, dpmpp_2m / karras). **fooocus_inpaint** (optional, off by default): lllyasviel's Fooocus inpaint patch ([Here](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint), models/inpaint, needs Acly's **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**) blends best on outpaints and fills but rebuilds what was there more than it adds. ⚠️ With both on, drop **control_strength** to about 0.5: Pony and Illustrious turn to noise at 1. ⚠️ **Outpaint: control_strength about 0.2.** At 1 the straight edge of the old picture reads as a real edge, and SDXL paints a window frame, fence or line along it. Inpaint stays at 1 (the mask is surrounded by your picture, so it holds the light and edges through the hole). 💡 A boolean and two floats into **control_strength** switches it with your inpaint / outpaint toggle. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact FaceDetailer chain with one node. Finds what you type (**hands, face, eyes**) with SAM 3 and redraws it at full detail. Each hand or face gets its own crop, scaled to about **inpaint_resolution** squared pixels, redrawn, then blended back in. The redraw reaches a little past the pasted area and its colour is matched to the original along the seam, so the edge does not show. **tone_match** (on): the redraw gets the original's brightness, contrast and colour back where it is pasted, keeping the new detail (a light redraw otherwise comes back flat and dull); turn it off when the redraw is meant to change colours. Changing denoise, steps or feather redraws without searching again. **grow** / **feather** shape the mask, **padding** is the context around each crop, **blend** mixes the original back in (1 = all redraw). Works with 4-D and 5-D latents (SDXL, Flux, Krea 2, Anima, Qwen, etc.). Leave **negative** empty for cfg 1 models, wire it for SDXL. Nothing found? The image passes through untouched and the node says so. Before/after wipe on the node with the found areas outlined. **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** takes the image, model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe; wire an **image**, **model** or **vae** into it to use that one instead (a node without a pipe changed the picture, a model with LoRAs on it, or a different model). It puts its result back in the pipe's image and leaves two things for the nodes after it: every area the detailers redrew (merged, so face + hands + eyes add up), which **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** carries to the new size (its **protected** output), and what SAM 3 found, so the same word is never searched twice. Both are tied to the picture they were made for and ignored if it changed in between. 💡 Faces: denoise 0.3, blend 0.8. **cfg** defaults to 1 on both versions (the pipe version no longer takes the main sampler's cfg_1, which made redraws drastic). 1 works for Krea 2, Flux, Z-Image and, at detailer denoise up to about 0.4, SDXL too (tested cfg 1 to 7: the same result). It never goes below 1: below 1 the redraw comes out speckled. 💡 If your positive describes the whole scene, wire a short prompt for the area into **inpaint_positive** (e.g. "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin"). Otherwise, at denoise 0.3 and up, the scene can get drawn into every crop. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Upscale that keeps the detailers' work. ### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

## Nodes

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node. Drag inside the source to reposition it. **free** or locked to a common aspect ratio, grey fill. Outputs **control_image**, **control_mask** (white = new area), **mask_image**, **width**, **height**. **hold_mask**: **snap_to_image** puts the box back on the image every run and passes the image through as is (so a new image always starts clean); **held** keeps the canvas you set up and passes the image through with it. **block** set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream when the mask is empty: with snap_to_image that means every run (drag the edges out, switch to held, run again), with held only if you have not pulled an edge out. Run once to get the preview. *note:* **snap_to** rounds the final size up to a multiple (8 by default), set it to 1 to turn that off. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draw a mask right on the node. Click to add points (no limit), drag to move, shift+click removes one. Flip the toggle to **pencil** for freehand. **smooth**, **invert**, **feather**, and **opacity** are built in. Undo and Clear buttons on the node. **block** (top widget) set to **if_empty_mask** stops everything downstream until you have drawn something, same idea as Impact Pack's Preview Bridge. Run once to get the preview. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tighten a mask with a **trimap**. **edge_erode** pulls the sure-foreground in from the mask edge, **edge_dilate** sets how far the unknown band reaches out. Only that band is decided by the **method** (**vitmatte** for hair and fine detail, **guided_filter** for speed, or **none**), so a narrower band means a tighter mask. Also **grow** (negative shrinks), **fix_gap**, **black_point** / **white_point**, **feather**, and **edge_color_spread** to cut background halos on the cutout. Plug a mask into **detail_region** (like hair) to give just that area a wider trimap (**detail_erode** / **detail_dilate**). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **trimap**. Before/after wipe on the node, same as the LC123 previews: hover and the after image sits left of the pointer. **preview_view** switches between cutout, mask and trimap. Run once to get the preview. 💡 Start with 10 / 10, then shrink both toward 3 for a tight edge. **Micro adjust:** every pixel value (**grow**, **fix_gap**, **edge_erode**, **edge_dilate**, the **detail_** ones, **feather**) takes decimals in 0.1 px steps, the points step by 0.001, and the edges are true circles, not blocks. Wire sliders in as **FLOAT** (INT sockets will not plug into these). ⚠️ Numbers are real pixels. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Cut the subject out with a BiRefNet model. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, and **on_background** (subject on a solid color). Optional **refine** (guided_filter or vitmatte) with the same trimap controls (**edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**), plus **grow**, **black_point** / **white_point**, and **feather**. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Uses ComfyUI's built-in background-removal loader, so no extra dependency. 💡 Raise **black_point** to clear faint haze, use **vitmatte** for hair. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Place a layer on a background and blend it. **x_percent** / **y_percent** (0.01 steps), **scale**, **aspect_ratio**, **rotate**, **mirror**, and 29 blend modes, with **opacity** in 0.1 steps and an optional **layer_mask** (multiplied with the layer's own alpha). **background_image** is optional: leave it off and the layer goes on a transparent canvas the size of the layer (RGBA out, like LayerStyle's V3). **transform_method**: lanczos, bicubic, bilinear, nearest. Outputs **image** and **mask** (where the layer landed). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Select things by describing them: type **hair, eyes, bikini** and each word is found and combined. **engine**: **grounding_dino + sam** (GroundingDINO finds boxes, SAM makes masks) or **sam3** (SAM 3 does both, using ComfyUI's built-in SAM 3 support). Then the same refine as Mask Refine (**refine**, **edge_erode** / **edge_dilate**, **black_point** / **white_point**) and a before/after wipe on the node. Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For sam3, **sam3_threshold** 0.5 is a good start; near 0.3 it invents matches for words that are not in the image. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Pick the parts of a person: **face**, **hair**, **body**, **clothes**, **accessories**, **background**, combined into one mask. **engine**: **segformer** (higher resolution, body is arms and legs only) or **mediapipe** (body includes torso and neck skin). Then the same refine as Mask Refine. No preview on the node (add LC Mask Refine after it if you want one). Outputs **cutout** (RGBA), **mask**, **raw_mask**. 💡 For skin work, enable **face** and **body**. |
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels. **mode**: **RGB** (each channel on its own, also removes color casts), **lum + sat**, **luminance**, **saturation**, or **mono**. Then **red** / **green** / **blue** balance, **brightness**, **contrast**, **saturation** trims, and **strength** to blend back toward the original. All in 0.1 steps. An optional **mask** limits both where the levels are measured and where the result is applied (an alpha channel works as the mask when none is connected). Pure torch, no extra dependency. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth map from one image, normalized 0-1 per image, **bright = near** unless **invert** is on. Reads the original Depth Anything V2 weights, so a copy you already have in `models/depthanything` works (it also finds the ones in comfyui_controlnet_aux). Outputs **depth** (3-channel image) and **depth_mask**. **resolution** in steps of 14. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's Depth Anything V2 (correlation 1.000). Model code is vendored, no extra package. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Surface normal map (RGB = XYZ) with the BAE network, the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. **resolution**, and **flip_y** for OpenGL vs DirectX. Matches comfyui_controlnet_aux's BAE (correlation 0.9999). Needs the `timm` package (the installer adds it if missing). 💡 Both maps are what LC Lighting Control in LC123 wants as its **depth_map** and **normal_map**. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well, not a blind centre crop: one render, every social format, nobody's head cut off. **aspect_ratio** uses the same presets as LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (or **custom**). **framing**: **widest** keeps as much picture as the format allows; **upper body**, **head & shoulders** and **face** frame tighter from the face size (character datasets). **faces**: **all** keeps every face in the crop, **largest** frames the main one (use it when posters or background people get picked up). **output_size**: **preset size** (e.g. 1080x1350) or **keep pixels**. SAM 3 finds the faces; wire a **mask** to frame anything else (a car, a product, a pet). Nothing found: a centre crop, and the console says so |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. The round handle turns it (hold **Shift** for 15° steps, or type the **angle**), the frame's square handles pad (drag out) or crop (drag in), and dragging inside the frame moves the picture. The **control_mask** is white where the model has to paint: the padding and the corners a turn opens up, so it goes straight into **LC Krea2 AnyPaint**. **fit**: **expand** starts the frame around the whole turned picture, **crop** at the largest box with no empty corners. **fill**: **gray** (what Krea 2 and AnyPaint expect), **edge** (stretches the outer pixels), **white**, **black**. **aspect** locks the output shape, **snap_to** rounds the size up. Run once to see the picture on the node. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with yijunwang2's **AnyPaint LoRA** ([Here](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint), put it in your loras folder), run the way it was trained. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. The model sees a small copy of the whole picture while it paints, so the new part matches the light and the scene, and a thin border around the mask is redrawn so the seam disappears. **prompt**: describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. **crop_to_mask** on for inpaint (the area is redrawn in its own crop at **inpaint_resolution**), off for outpaint. **composite**: **keep original** pastes back only the painted area, **raw** is the whole redraw. Use Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1. 💡 "Remove the car" leaves a flat blob: describe what should be there instead. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for **Z-Image** (Turbo / Base): the same crop, keep, border and seam fix, painted by Alibaba's **Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1** in inpaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1), put it in models/model_patches; the 8steps one is for Turbo). The only difference from the Krea 2 node is the top two widgets: **control** (the union patch) and **control_strength**. Describe the whole finished picture in the prompt. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any **SDXL** checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious, your finetunes), no LoRA needed. Painted by xinsir's **ControlNet Union SDXL ProMax** in repaint mode ([Here](https://huggingface.co/xinsir/controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0), put the promax file in models/controlnet). **prompt**: describe what goes in the mask, short ("a red bucket full of fish on the pier"). To remove something, describe what should be there instead, or leave it empty and it fills from the picture around the mask (outpaint still wants the scene described). SDXL uses a real **negative** and **cfg** (25 steps, cfg 5, dpmpp_2m / karras). **fooocus_inpaint** (optional, off by default): lllyasviel's Fooocus inpaint patch ([Here](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/fooocus_inpaint), models/inpaint, needs Acly's **ComfyUI Inpaint Nodes**) blends best on outpaints and fills but rebuilds what was there more than it adds. ⚠️ With both on, drop **control_strength** to about 0.5: Pony and Illustrious turn to noise at 1. ⚠️ **Outpaint: control_strength about 0.2.** At 1 the straight edge of the old picture reads as a real edge, and SDXL paints a window frame, fence or line along it. Inpaint stays at 1 (the mask is surrounded by your picture, so it holds the light and edges through the hole). 💡 A boolean and two floats into **control_strength** switches it with your inpaint / outpaint toggle. |

Each hand or face gets its own crop, scaled to about **inpaint_resolution** squared pixels, redrawn, then blended back in. The redraw reaches a little past the pasted area and its colour is matched to the original along the seam, so the edge does not show. **tone_match** (on): the redraw gets the original's brightness, contrast and colour back where it is pasted, keeping the new detail (a light redraw otherwise comes back flat and dull); turn it off when the redraw is meant to change colours. Changing denoise, steps or feather redraws without searching again. **grow** / **feather** shape the mask, **padding** is the context around each crop, **blend** mixes the original back in (1 = all redraw). Works with 4-D and 5-D latents (SDXL, Flux, Krea 2, Anima, Qwen, etc.). Leave **negative** empty for cfg 1 models, wire it for SDXL. Nothing found? The image passes through untouched and the node says so. Before/after wipe on the node with the found areas outlined. **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** takes the image, model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe; wire an **image**, **model** or **vae** into it to use that one instead (a node without a pipe changed the picture, a model with LoRAs on it, or a different model). It puts its result back in the pipe's image and leaves two things for the nodes after it: every area the detailers redrew (merged, so face + hands + eyes add up), which **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe)** carries to the new size (its **protected** output), and what SAM 3 found, so the same word is never searched twice. Both are tied to the picture they were made for and ignored if it changed in between. 💡 Faces: denoise 0.3, blend 0.8. **cfg** defaults to 1 on both versions (the pipe version no longer takes the main sampler's cfg_1, which made redraws drastic). 1 works for Krea 2, Flux, Z-Image and, at detailer denoise up to about 0.4, SDXL too (tested cfg 1 to 7: the same result). It never goes below 1: below 1 the redraw comes out speckled. 💡 If your positive describes the whole scene, wire a short prompt for the area into **inpaint_positive** (e.g. "close-up of a woman's face, natural skin"). Otherwise, at denoise 0.3 and up, the scene can get drawn into every crop. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Upscale that keeps the detailers' work. # Total nodes

**252 nodes** across 5 packs. Deprecated nodes are listed but not counted.

| Pack | Nodes | Version | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| LC123 | 159 | v1.54.1 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes) |
| LC AV | 26 | v0.4.2 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes) |
| LC MaskMaker | 29 | v0.29.1 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes) |
| LC Vision | 12 | v1.6.15 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes) |
| LC ModelBuilder | 26 | v0.7.2 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes) |

---

## LC123 v1.54.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for CivitAI's terms). Off until you switch it on. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. Starts on LC Crushed Blacks at 0.3. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Draw boxes on a picture for Flux 3 or MOSS Image: name each box, pick new, change, move or remove, and describe the result. For MOSS a box can be a character and get its own palette. Works in classic and Nodes 2.0. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** (JS only) | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser. |
| **LC Bypasser** (JS only) | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |

| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |

## LC Vision v1.6.15

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Showrunner (BETA) 🎬** | Plans a long MiniMax H3 video as CUT / CONTINUE segments, fixes each join to how the last segment really ended, and saves / loads the project file (shot list, references, settings). |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | Quality gate: yes/no checks on hands, faces, text, artifacts, prompt match and your own questions. Flags a bad render, or blocks everything after it. |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | The story for the Showrunner, filled in like a form: the place, the cast and one row per shot. Suggests the segment count and warns about lines too long for their shot. No AI involved. |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Builder (BETA) 🎞️** | Pictures for a Showrunner movie: finds what the project is missing (faces, places, anchors) and makes one prompt, latent and seed per picture for the sampler. |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Save (BETA) 🎞️** | Saves the Storyboard Builder's pictures into the project. 📂 Load on the Showrunner adds them to the Reference Assembler. |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Sheet (BETA) 🎞️** | The storyboard on the node: a card per picture. ✅ Use puts it in the Reference Assembler, ↻ makes it again, ✎ changes its prompt. Nothing to wire. |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | Kept for older workflows: LC Vision Showrunner now fixes the joins itself. |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | Prompts for SDXL, Pony and Illustrious from one image or a rough idea: a short or detailed caption, real Danbooru tags, or a sentence plus tags. Optional quality tags and a matching negative. |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). Wire LC MOSS Layout Prompt into it and it enhances the scene and boxes, boxes kept. |
