## LC ModelBuilder v0.7.2

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Anima Block Merge Advanced** | The Krea2 Block Merge Advanced for Anima: a curve over its 28 blocks plus sliders for the x embedder, timestep embedder and norm, LLM adapter and final layer. Presets. |
| **LC Anima LoRA Block Scan** | The Krea2 LoRA Block Scan for Anima, scoring anime faces with CCIP. |
| **LC Anima LoRA Editor** | The Krea2 LoRA Editor for Anima: same controls, Anima's 28 blocks and layer types. |
| **LC Anima LoRA Merge** | The Krea2 LoRA Merge for Anima: two to four Anima LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve. |
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. metadata: keep all, or necessary only (no workflow or training details). |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. Same metadata switch. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. Photo (ArcFace) or anime (CCIP) mode. |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | What is this model made of? Its recipe from your fingerprint library, block by block: which models were merged and at what ratio, merged-in LoRAs with their strength, how sure it is of each, and a heatmap. It can only name what is in the library. |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | Goes through your folders and stores a small fingerprint (about 1 MB) of every model and LoRA, with its family. Once a file is in, the original can go. Reruns only add what is new. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Bake 🍞** | Bakes up to 4 LoRAs into a model file and saves it as a new model, with an optional per-block curve. Reads every LoRA format ComfyUI reads and writes the recipe into the file. Runs on the CPU, no VRAM needed. |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA Save** | Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | One model against a reference, layer by layer, from the weights themselves: the same model at another precision, built on it, a block merge (the chart shows which blocks) or not related. With a LoRA: whether it was merged in and at about what strength. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | Saves a smaller copy of a model: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 or int4 (load with the stock loader) or GGUF Q8_0 to Q2_K. From the wired MODEL (LoRAs baked in) or straight from a file of any size. |
| **LC MOSS Block Merge Advanced** | Merges MOSS Image models with a draggable per-layer ratio curve across the 42 layers, plus sliders for the parts outside them (picture in, prompt in, timestep, modulation, final layer). Presets save and load. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | Cleans the metadata out of a model you already saved (embedded workflow, training details, titles). The weights are copied byte for byte, never loaded, so it loads exactly as before. Writes a _clean copy or replaces the original. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |

## LC123 v1.54.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | 根据合规列表从提示词中去掉被标记的词，仅作辅助（你仍需对 CivitAI 的条款负责）。开启前不起作用。 |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | 为 Image Saver 类节点分别生成文件名和路径输出，可选在路径中加 prefix 和 timestamp。 |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，为每个区域得到单独的 conditioning 和遮罩，用于 Anima 区域提示词。 |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 只要任何一个连接的输入为空、被静音或被 bypass，就输出 true。 |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，输出一个空值和一个非空值 float。 |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，输出一个空值和一个非空值整数。 |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 传递所选索引处的输入，忽略其他槽位。 |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 从 2 到 20 个输入中选出第一个已连接的，并锁定为它的类型。 |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | 把 LC LoRA Loader Stack（或任何插件包）的 LORA_STACK 应用到 model 和/或 clip。 |
| **LC Apply LUT** | 应用 models/luts 中的 .cube 3D LUT，强度 0 到 2。默认使用 LC Crushed Blacks，强度 0.3。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 把图像、遮罩、尺寸、latent、batch 和分辨率打包进 LC_PIPE，或编辑已有的 pipe，只覆盖已连线的接口。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | 把 LC_PIPE 里的宽高比字段拆成单独的接口，并继续传递 pipe。 |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | 自动校正白平衡，可选算法、强度混合和前后擦除对比。 |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 输出完整步数的 sigmas（不含 denoise），用来给 LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) 供数据，做双 pass 采样。 |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 从自动增长的槽位中合成图像 batch，忽略被静音或缺失的，并把后面的图像缩放到与第一张一致。 |
| **LC Bloom** | 根据亮部加上辉光，有 Bloom、Pro-Mist（柔光滤镜）和 Halation（胶片边缘光晕）三种模式。 |
| **LC Boolean** | 把 boolean、int 或 float 转成干净的 true/false，并显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | 输出其开关相反的值。 |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | 根据 boolean 在 on_true 或 on_false 输入（任意类型）中二选一。 |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 一个可以连到任何地方的普通 boolean 开关。 |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | 在图片上为 Flux 3 或 MOSS Image 画框：给每个框命名，选择新增、修改、移动或移除，并描述结果。在 MOSS 中，一个框可以是一个角色，并拥有自己的调色板。经典画布和 Nodes 2.0 都能用。 |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 收集其左侧的节点，这样一个 hub 可以通过 OPT_CONNECTION 一起静音或 bypass 它们。 |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** (JS only) | 一个只有控件的 LC Bypasser、LC Mute 或 LC Groups Bypasser 遥控器。 |
| **LC Bypasser** (JS only) | 用开关或 BOOLEAN 输入，在一个地方 bypass 所有链接的节点。 |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | 把 RGB 通道错开来模拟镜头色散，每个通道可设置像素量和方向。 |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 把图像的颜色匹配到参考图（AdaIN / mean-std），可选皮肤保护和遮罩。 |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 一个下拉菜单，连接后会镜像另一个节点的 combo 选项（sampler、scheduler 等）。 |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 一个节点上最多 16 个滑块和开关，各有自己的输出。每行的齿轮可设置类型（数字或 boolean）、名称、范围、步长以及 INT 或 FLOAT。接到数字或 boolean 输入上的新行会复制该输入的设置。 |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 构建你自己的选项列表，输出选中的文本及其索引。 |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 一个遥控器，可以从别处为 LC Custom Combo 选择选项。 |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | 注入按 1 减去你的 denoise 值缩放的 latent 噪点，使用你给采样器的同一个 denoise。 |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | 用深度图做大气雾、光线包裹和带真实散景的景深，有共享的预设风格。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 按原版 Detail Daemon 的调度，在一段步数内向模型隐藏一点噪点，从而增加细节。有 Look only（默认）、classic 和 keep structure 三种模式。采样器版本。接到 low pass 采样器上。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 同样的 Detail Daemon，做成模型补丁，用于普通 KSampler。 |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | 从 LC_PIPE 中拆出 detailer 设置（模型、提示词、seed、cfg、sampler、scheduler、steps）。protect_mask（底部）：pipe detailer 重绘过的区域。 |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | 用一个值对宽和高做加、减、乘、除，并把结果取整。 |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 沿某个角度和长度的动态模糊，通过拖动节点上的箭头设置。 |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 把图像 B 叠在图像 A 上，运行一次后可以直接在节点上调整不透明度，无需重新生成。 |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | 为原生 Save Image 节点生成 filename_prefix，并创建文件夹。 |
| **LC Film Grain** | 添加胶片颗粒，可设置数量、对比度、大小以及单色或彩色选项。 |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | 为整段视频添加同样的颗粒：GPU 处理，每次几帧，带进度条。颗粒大小按视频尺寸来定，所以压缩后仍然保留。 |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | 通过预设和强度混合，得到黑白胶片效果。 |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | 通过预设（toe、shoulder、gamma）和强度混合，得到彩色胶片效果。 |
| **LC Float Compare** | 输出两个 float 中较大或较小的那个。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | 把框以模型训练时所用的表格形式加进 Flux 3 提示词。在提示词里写 <1>、<2> 分别代表框 1、框 2。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | 为 Flux 3 的正面和负面提供最多 4 张参考图，以及模型需要的负面和 latent 尺寸。 |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 读取图像的宽、高、百万像素、长边、batch 大小和宽高比。 |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** (JS only) | 在一个地方 bypass 整个分组，每个分组一个开关。 |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 基础调色（色相、饱和度、亮度、对比度），带轻度锐化或柔化。 |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | 按字母顺序把整个文件夹加载为一个 batch，带 max_images 和 start_index。 |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 用紧凑的下拉菜单和稳定的图像区域，比较大批量的图像。 |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | 在节点上拖动方框和手柄来裁剪，可选锁定宽高比。 |
| **LC Image Denoise** | 智能去噪，带模糊强度、边缘保护和混合。 |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | 按系数和亮度方法向灰度去饱和。 |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 把一个 batch 的图像排成网格，可选间隙、轮廓和边框。 |
| **LC Image Label** | 用来给工作流做标注的浮动图片贴纸，支持拖放上传（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Image Pass** | 让图像原样通过。关闭后，下一个节点在这个输入上什么也收不到，并在没有它的情况下运行。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 把最多 16 张参考图打包进一个 pipe，接口会像 Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 那样增长。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | 把图像参考 pipe 拆回 image_1 到 image_16 的原槽位，pipe 在最前。 |
| **LC Image RGB** | 分别偏移每个颜色通道，带整体强度。 |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | 节点上的前后对比滑动条，输出是烘焙好的分割图，可直接保存，分隔线的宽度和颜色可自定。 |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | 从自动增长的槽位把图像并排或叠放拼接，带 match size、align 和可选间隙。 |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 把图像缩放到指定的总百万像素数，并输出最终分辨率。 |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 把图像和/或遮罩缩放到预设、自定义尺寸、倍数或百万像素数，按 divisible_by 的倍数取整。 |
| **LC Int Compare** | 输出两个整数中较大或较小的那个。 |
| **LC Int Split** | 在一个小数分割点把总数拆成 a + b，保证 a + b 始终等于总数。 |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | 把 boolean、int 或 float 转换后输出相反的值。 |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | 如果接入的节点被 bypass 或静音，就输出 true，实时读取，无需排队运行。 |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | 用分隔符连接多个字符串，并跳过空的。 |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，使用 krea2 CLIP 类型得到区域 conditioning。 |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | 用来给工作流做标注的浮动文字标签，支持字体、颜色、描边和阴影（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | 保留最后生成的图像用于前后对比，即使断开连接后也在。Hold until seed change 会保留某个 seed 的第一张图，用来与调整后的结果比较。 |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)** | 在搜索中隐藏。旧工作流仍能运行它。请改用 Lens Profile、Vignette 和 Film Grain。 |
| **LC Lens Profile** | 应用或校正指定的镜头配置文件，强度可调。 |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | 用 lift、gamma、gain 和 offset 为暗部、中间调和高光调色。 |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | 用一两个聚光灯或太阳光、色温、色片以及硬或软投影为图像重新打光。 |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | 旧工作流仍然能运行它。请改用 LC Lighting Control V2。 |
| **LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️** | 构建与 LC LoRA Loader 相同的 LoRA 列表，输出为 LORA_STACK。 |
| **LC LoRA Loader 🎚️** | 在一个节点里应用任意数量的 LoRA，每行都有启用、强度和拖动排序。 |
| **LC LoRA Loader (single) 🎚️** | 单独一行的 LC LoRA Loader（开/关、文件夹选择器、强度、Info），把 turbo 或风格 LoRA 放在它自己的位置上。只作用于模型，不能添加或删除行。 |
| **LC Mask Pass** | 让蒙版通过。关闭后，下一个节点在没有蒙版的情况下运行。用它来代替绕过生成蒙版的节点。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe** | 打包或编辑一个 H3 pipe，包含 MiniMax H3 的提示词、参考和设置。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | 把 LC MiniMax H3 pipe 拆成单独的接口。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2** | 拆开 H3 pipe V2，另外增加 prompt、steps、cfg、seed、sampler 和 scheduler 输出。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2** | 打包或编辑 H3 pipe V2，它还携带 prompt、steps、cfg、seed、sampler 和 scheduler。 |
| **LC Model Info ℹ️** | 接入任意 MODEL：它会沿着连线向上游追溯（LoRA 加载器、merge、LC Model Optimizer），只读取每个文件的头部。显示保存节点写入的工作流（基础模型、带强度的 LoRA、merge）、Kohya 训练信息和触发词、模型卡字段、GGUF 类型。直接在节点上实时显示，无需排队运行。模型照常通过。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡** | 与 LC Model Optimizer 相同，另外有 LC_PIPE 输出（model 2 携带 Ideogram 4 的第二个模型）。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | 与 LC Model Optimizer Video 相同，另外有 LC_PIPE 输出（vae 2 携带音频 VAE）。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | 视频版：为 MiniMax H3 和 LTX 2.5 / 2.3 加载模型、文本编码器、视频与音频 VAE 以及 latent 放大器。在 H3 上，Spectrum 和 Veda 安装后可以手动打开（spectrum / veda 控件）。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer ⚡** | 加载适合你显卡的模型、文本编码器和 VAE，并启用在这张卡上有效的加速。首次运行时下载推荐的文件。涵盖 Krea 2（Turbo 和 Raw）、SDXL、Illustrious、Pony 等，任何其他模型可用 Custom。MOSS Image 和 Krea 2 内置 Spectrum（可用 spectrum 控件关闭）。 |

| **LC Touch Mask (BETA) 👆** | 精确地给一样东西做蒙版：圈住它，SAM 3 就会找到它的边缘。点一下扩展到下一个更大的东西（脸、脸 + 头发、头、整个人），双击退回一步。Ctrl + 画 用来剪掉。内置阈值、平滑和精细的边缘处理。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | 内置 VOSR 2.0 的快速低显存放大：在不重绘画面的情况下锐化并增加细微细节。一次 1.5x 到 4x，两次可到 6x 和 8x。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | 同上，用于 LC pipe，放在 pipe detailer 之后。把 detailer 的区域带到新尺寸（protected 输出），供 LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture 使用。 |

## LC Vision v1.6.15

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Showrunner (BETA) 🎬** | 把长 MiniMax H3 视频规划为 CUT / CONTINUE 片段，根据上一段实际的结尾修正每处衔接，并保存 / 加载项目文件（镜头列表、参考、设置）。 |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | 质量关卡：对手、脸、文字、伪影、提示词匹配以及你自己的问题做是/否检查。标记不合格的渲染，或阻止它后面的一切。 |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | 给 Showrunner 的故事，像表单一样填写：场景、角色，以及每个镜头一行。会建议片段数量，并对相对镜头而言过长的台词发出警告。不涉及 AI。 |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Builder (BETA) 🎞️** | 为 Showrunner 电影准备图片：找出项目还缺什么（人脸、地点、锚点），为每张图生成一个提示词、latent 和种子，交给采样器。 |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Save (BETA) 🎞️** | 把 Storyboard Builder 的图片存进项目。在 Showrunner 上点 📂 Load 会把它们加入 Reference Assembler。 |
| **LC Vision Storyboard Sheet (BETA) 🎞️** | 节点上的分镜板：每张图一张卡片。✅ Use 把它放进 Reference Assembler，↻ 重新生成，✎ 修改它的提示词。不需要连线。 |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | 为旧工作流保留：LC Vision Showrunner 现在自己就能修正衔接。 |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | 根据一张图或一个粗略的想法，为 SDXL、Pony 和 Illustrious 生成提示词：简短或详细的描述、真实的 Danbooru 标签，或一句话加标签。可选质量标签和匹配的负面提示词。 |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | 用已加载的 LC Vision 模型、一条指令、最多三张参考图和一段参考视频生成文本。 |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | 加载 Qwen-VL GGUF 模型及其视觉投影。keep_model_loaded 关闭时，Vision 节点用完后会卸载它，让图像模型独占整张显卡。 |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | 一次调用把视频规划成若干连续片段，每段都写成一个独立完整的 MiniMax H3 提示词。 |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | 通过 LC Vision 模型、用预设指令改写提示词（仅文本）。把 LC MOSS Layout Prompt 接进来，它会增强场景和框，框保持不变。 |

## LC ModelBuilder v0.7.2

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Anima Block Merge Advanced** | Anima 版的 Krea2 Block Merge Advanced：一条覆盖 28 个 block 的曲线，外加 x embedder、timestep embedder 和 norm、LLM adapter 以及 final layer 的滑块。带预设。 |
| **LC Anima LoRA Block Scan** | Anima 版的 Krea2 LoRA Block Scan，用 CCIP 给动漫人脸打分。 |
| **LC Anima LoRA Editor** | Anima 版的 Krea2 LoRA Editor：控件相同，换成 Anima 的 28 个 block 和层类型。 |
| **LC Anima LoRA Merge** | Anima 版的 Krea2 LoRA Merge：两到四个 Anima LoRA，按 block 设置 A / B 曲线。 |
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | 保存一体式 checkpoint（model、clip、vae），带 enabled 开关可跳过保存。metadata：保留全部，或仅保留必要信息（不含工作流或训练细节）。 |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | 只保存 diffusion 模型，不含 clip 或 vae。同样的 metadata 开关。 |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | 给一批图像里的人脸有多相似打分（0 到 1，越低 = 越多样），并为合照给出人群得分。有真人照片（ArcFace）或动漫（CCIP）模式。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | 这个模型是由什么构成的？根据你的指纹库给出它的配方，逐 block 分析：合并了哪些模型、比例多少，融入的 LoRA 及其强度，对每一项有多大把握，还有热力图。它只能说出库里有的东西。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | 遍历你的文件夹，为每个模型和 LoRA 保存一个小小的指纹（约 1 MB）及其所属家族。文件入库之后，原文件就可以删除。重新运行只会添加新的。 |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | 合并 Krea2 checkpoint，在 28 个 block 上有可拖动的逐 block 比例曲线，另有命名区域的滑块。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | 通过逐个关闭 block 组，找出 LoRA 在哪里锁定了人脸或改变了整张图，并为 Editor 推荐 block 曲线。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | 加载 Krea 2 LoRA，可对 28 个 block 逐个调高或调低，分别缩放 attention 和 MLP，并柔化尖峰。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | 用逐 block 的 A / B 曲线（sum 或 TIES）合并两到四个 Krea 2 LoRA。 |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | 放大或衰减单个 Krea2 checkpoint 权重的特定区域（不是合并）。 |
| **LC LoRA Bake 🍞** | 把最多 4 个 LoRA 烘焙进模型文件，另存为新模型，可选按 block 的曲线。能读取 ComfyUI 支持的所有 LoRA 格式，并把配方写进文件。在 CPU 上运行，不需要显存。 |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | 把 finetune 变成 LoRA（finetune 减去它的 base）：所有层、仅 block 或自定义 block 列表。未改变的层会被排除。 |
| **LC LoRA Save** | 把编辑或合并后的 LoRA 保存为标准文件，所有编辑都已烘焙进去，可选新的 rank，带 enabled 和 embed_workflow 开关。 |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 从权重本身出发，逐层比较一个模型与一个参考：是另一种精度的同一模型、基于它构建的、block merge（图表显示是哪些 block）还是无关。对 LoRA：它是否被合并进去，以及大约的强度。 |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 合并以不同精度存储的两个模型（bf16 与 fp8、int8、nvfp4 或 GGUF，顺序不限）。结果保持全精度。 |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | 保存模型的较小副本：fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8 或 int4（用原生加载器加载）或 GGUF Q8_0 到 Q2_K。可来自接入的 MODEL（已烘焙 LoRA），或直接来自任意大小的文件。 |
| **LC MOSS Block Merge Advanced** | 合并 MOSS Image 模型，用可拖动的逐层比例曲线覆盖 42 层，外加层外部分（图像输入、提示词输入、timestep、modulation、final layer）的滑块。预设可保存和加载。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B 测试的对决计数器：#1 Win、Tie 和 #2 Win 按钮，领先者和百分比显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | 清除你已保存模型里的元数据（内嵌工作流、训练细节、标题）。权重逐字节复制，从不加载，所以加载效果和之前完全一样。写出 _clean 副本，或替换原文件。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 用最多六个 VAE 解码相同的 latent，并排显示 1:1 细节裁剪、锐度数值，以及每个与第一个的差距。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 合并同一家族的两个 VAE 的解码器，从粗略形状到精细质感。编码器仍是 base 的，所以结果依然适配为它制作的模型。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | 以 fp32、bf16 或 fp16 把 VAE 保存到 models/vae。 |

## LC123 v1.54.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| ノード | 機能 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | コンプライアンスリストを使って、プロンプトからフラグ付きの用語を取り除きます。あくまで補助です（CivitAI の規約に対する責任はあなたにあります）。オンにするまではオフです。 |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Image Saver 系ノード向けに、ファイル名とパスを別々に出力します。prefix-in-path とタイムスタンプも任意で使えます。 |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | ノード上で RGB の領域を塗ると、領域ごとに別々の conditioning とマスクが得られます。Anima の regional prompting 用です。 |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 接続された入力のどれかが空、ミュート、またはバイパスされていれば true を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Any Empty Bool と同じ空判定を行い、空の float と空でない float を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Any Empty Bool と同じ空判定を行い、空の整数と空でない整数を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 選んだインデックスの入力を通し、ほかのスロットは無視します。 |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 2〜20個の入力のうち最初に接続されたものを選び、その型にロックします。 |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader Stack（または任意のパック）の LORA_STACK を、model や clip に適用します。 |
| **LC Apply LUT** | models/luts の .cube 3D LUT を、0〜2 の strength で適用します。デフォルトは LC Crushed Blacks の 0.3 です。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 画像、マスク、サイズ、latent、バッチ、解像度を LC_PIPE にまとめるか、既存のものを編集します。接続したソケットだけが上書きされます。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE のアスペクト比のフィールドを個別のソケットに展開し、pipe はそのまま渡します。 |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | アルゴリズムを選んで、ホワイトバランスを自動補正します。strength のブレンドと before/after ワイプ付き。 |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 全ステップ数ぶんの sigmas（denoise なし）を出力します。デュアルパスのサンプリングで LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) に渡すためのものです。 |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 自動で増えるスロットから画像をバッチ化します。ミュートされたものや欠けているものは無視し、後の画像は最初の画像に合わせてリサイズします。 |
| **LC Bloom** | 明るい部分から光のにじみを加えます。Bloom、Pro-Mist（ディフュージョンフィルター）、Halation（フィルムのエッジの光）の各モードがあります。 |
| **LC Boolean** | boolean、int、float をきれいな true/false に変換し、ノード上に表示します。 |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | トグルの反対を出力します。 |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean に基づいて、on_true か on_false の入力（任意の型）を選びます。 |
| **LC Boolean Value** | どこにでも接続できる、シンプルな boolean トグルです。 |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Flux 3 や MOSS Image 用に画像の上にボックスを描きます。ボックスごとに名前を付け、新規・変更・移動・削除を選んで、結果を説明します。MOSS ではボックスをキャラクターにして、専用のパレットを持たせることもできます。クラシックと Nodes 2.0 の両方で動きます。 |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 左側のノードを集めて、ハブが OPT_CONNECTION 経由でそれらをまとめてミュートまたはバイパスできるようにします。 |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** (JS only) | LC Bypasser、LC Mute、LC Groups Bypasser 用の、ウィジェットだけのリモコンです。 |
| **LC Bypasser** (JS only) | 1か所から、リンクされたノードをトグルまたは BOOLEAN 入力でバイパスします。 |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB チャンネルをずらして、レンズの色収差を疑似的に再現します。チャンネルごとにピクセル量と方向を設定できます。 |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 画像の色をリファレンスに合わせます（AdaIN / mean-std）。肌の保護とマスクも任意で使えます。 |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 他のノードの combo（sampler、scheduler など）に接続すると、そのオプションをミラーするドロップダウンです。 |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 1つのノードに最大16個のスライダーとオン/オフスイッチをまとめ、それぞれが専用の出力を持ちます。行の歯車で、タイプ(数値か boolean)、名前、範囲、ステップ、INT か FLOAT を設定します。数値や boolean の入力につないだ新しい行は、その入力の設定をコピーします。 |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 自分だけの選択肢リストを作り、選んだテキストとそのインデックスを出力します。 |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 別の場所から LC Custom Combo の選択を切り替えるリモコンです。 |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | サンプラーに渡すのと同じ denoise を使って、1 から denoise を引いた値でスケールした latent ノイズを注入します。 |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | depth map を使って、大気のもや、ライトラップ、本物のボケ付きの被写界深度を作ります。共通のルックも使えます。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 元の Detail Daemon のスケジュールに沿って、ステップの一部の区間でモデルからノイズを少し隠すことで、細かいディテールを加えます。Look only（デフォルト）、classic、keep structure のモードがあります。サンプラー版です。low pass サンプラーに接続します。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 同じ Detail Daemon を model patch にしたものです。通常の KSampler 用です。 |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE から detailer の設定（モデル、プロンプト、seed、cfg、sampler、scheduler、steps）を展開します。protect_mask（一番下）: pipe detailer が描き直したエリア。 |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | width と height に対して、1つの値で加算、減算、乗算、除算を行い、結果を整数に丸めます。 |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 1つの角度と長さに沿ったモーションブラーです。ノード上の矢印をドラッグして設定します。 |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 画像 B を画像 A に重ね、1回実行したあとは再生成せずに、ノード上で不透明度を調整できます。 |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | ネイティブの Save Image ノード用に filename_prefix を作り、フォルダも作成します。 |
| **LC Film Grain** | フィルムグレインを加えます。amount、contrast、size、モノ/カラーのオプション付き。 |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | クリップ全体に同じグレインを適用します。GPU で数フレームずつ処理し、プログレスバーが出ます。グレインは動画のサイズに合わせてあるので、圧縮にも耐えます。 |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | プリセットから白黒フィルムの見た目にします。strength のブレンド付き。 |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | プリセット（toe、shoulder、gamma）からカラーフィルムの見た目にします。strength のブレンド付き。 |
| **LC Float Compare** | 2つの float の大きいほう、または小さいほうを出力します。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | Flux 3 のプロンプトに、モデルが学習した形式の表としてボックスを追加します。プロンプトに <1>、<2> と書くと、ボックス1、ボックス2を指します。 |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | Flux 3 用に、positive と negative に最大4枚のリファレンス画像を渡します。モデルが必要とする negative と latent サイズも出力します。 |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 画像の width、height、メガピクセル、長辺、バッチサイズ、アスペクト比を読み取ります。 |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** (JS only) | 1か所から、グループ全体をバイパスします。グループごとに1つのトグルがあります。 |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 基本的なカラーグレーディング（hue、saturation、brightness、contrast）と、軽いシャープ/ソフト化。 |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | フォルダ全体を、アルファベット順の1つのバッチとして読み込みます。max_images と start_index 付き。 |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 大量の画像バッチを、コンパクトなドロップダウンと安定した画像エリアで比較します。 |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | ノード上のボックスとハンドルをドラッグしてクロップします。アスペクト比のロックも任意で使えます。 |
| **LC Image Denoise** | blur strength、エッジ保持、ブレンド付きのスマートなデノイズです。 |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | factor と輝度の方式を使って、グレースケールに向けて彩度を落とします。 |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 画像のバッチをグリッドに配置します。gap、アウトライン、ボーダーは任意です。 |
| **LC Image Label** | ワークフローに注釈をつけるための浮動画像ステッカーです。ドラッグ＆ドロップでアップロードできます（ソケットなし）。 |
| **LC Image Pass** | 画像をそのまま通します。オフにすると、次のノードはその入力に何も受け取らず、それなしで実行されます。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 最大16枚のリファレンス画像を1つの pipe にまとめます。ソケットは Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 のように増えます。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | image ref pipe を、元のスロットの image_1〜image_16 に展開します。pipe が先です。 |
| **LC Image RGB** | 各カラーチャンネルを別々にオフセットします。全体の strength 付き。 |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | ノード上のビフォー/アフターのワイプで、出力は保存用に焼き込んだ分割画像です。仕切り線の幅と色は自由に決められます。 |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | 自動で増えるスロットから、画像を横または縦に並べて結合します。match size、align、gap は任意です。 |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 画像を合計メガピクセル数にスケールし、結果の解像度を出力します。 |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 画像やマスクを、プリセット、カスタムサイズ、倍率、メガピクセル数のいずれかにリサイズします。サイズは divisible_by の倍数になります。 |
| **LC Int Compare** | 2つの整数の大きいほう、または小さいほうを出力します。 |
| **LC Int Split** | 合計を小数の分割点で a + b に分割します。a + b は常に合計と一致します。 |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | boolean、int、float を boolean に変換し、反対を出力します。 |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | 接続されたノードがバイパスまたはミュートされていれば true を出力します。キューに入れなくても、リアルタイムで読み取ります。 |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | 複数の文字列を区切り文字で連結し、空のものはスキップします。 |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | ノード上で RGB の領域を塗り、krea2 の CLIP タイプを使って regional conditioning を得ます。 |

| **🌱LC Seed** | このノードだけをキューに入れたときにも動作するモードを持つ、ユーティリティ seed です。 |

| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | GroundingDINO + SAM または SAM 3 を使い、言葉で説明したものを選択します。エッジの refine も任意です。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | SEGS / Impact の detailer の代わりになります。入力したもの（手、顔、目）を SAM 3 で見つけ、それぞれを専用のアップスケールしたクロップで描き直してから、元にブレンドします。 |

## LC Vision v1.6.15

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

## LC ModelBuilder v0.7.2

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | 28ブロックにわたるドラッグ可能なブロックごとの比率カーブと、名前付き領域のスライダーで、Krea2 チェックポイントをマージします。 |

| **LC LoRA Save** | 編集またはマージした LoRA を、すべての編集を焼き込んだ標準ファイルとして保存します。新しい rank にもできます。enabled と embed_workflow のスイッチ付き。 |

| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | モデルの小さなコピーを保存します: fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8、int4(標準のローダーで読み込めます)または GGUF の Q8_0 から Q2_K。配線した MODEL(LoRA を焼き込み済み)から、または任意のサイズのファイルから直接作れます。 |
| **LC MOSS Block Merge Advanced** | MOSS Image のモデルを、42 レイヤーにわたるドラッグできるレイヤーごとの比率カーブでマージします。レイヤー外の部分（画像入力、プロンプト入力、timestep、modulation、final layer）にはスライダーがあります。プリセットの保存と読み込みができます。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B テスト用の直接対決カウンターです: #1 Win、Tie、#2 Win のボタンがあり、リーダーとパーセンテージがノード上に表示されます。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | すでに保存したモデルから、メタデータ(埋め込みワークフロー、学習の詳細、タイトル)を消去します。重みはバイト単位でコピーされ、読み込まれることはないので、以前とまったく同じように読み込めます。_clean コピーを書き出すか、元のファイルを置き換えます。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 同じ latent を最大6つの VAE でデコードし、1:1 のディテールクロップ、シャープネスの数値、最初のものからどれだけ離れているかを並べて表示します。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 同じファミリーの2つの VAE のデコーダーを、大まかな形から細かいテクスチャまでマージします。エンコーダーはベースのものが残るので、結果はそれ用のモデルにもそのまま合います。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | VAE を models/vae に fp32、bf16、fp16 で保存します。 |

## LC123 v1.54.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 노드 | 기능 |

| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 전체 step 수에 대한 sigmas를 출력합니다 (denoise 없음). 듀얼 패스 샘플링용 LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)에 넣으려고 만들었습니다. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 자동으로 늘어나는 슬롯에서 이미지를 배치로 묶습니다. 뮤트되었거나 없는 것은 무시하고, 뒤의 이미지는 첫 이미지 크기에 맞춥니다. |
| **LC Bloom** | Bloom, Pro-Mist(디퓨전 필터), Halation(필름 가장자리 글로우) 모드로 밝은 영역에서 빛 번짐을 추가합니다. |
| **LC Boolean** | boolean, int, float를 깔끔한 true/false로 바꾸고 노드에 표시합니다. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | 토글의 반대 값을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean에 따라 on_true 또는 on_false 입력(모든 타입)을 선택합니다. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 어디에든 연결할 수 있는 단순한 boolean 토글입니다. |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Flux 3나 MOSS Image용으로 그림 위에 박스를 그립니다. 박스마다 이름을 붙이고 new, change, move, remove 중에서 고른 뒤 결과를 설명합니다. MOSS에서는 박스를 캐릭터로 만들어 전용 팔레트를 줄 수 있습니다. 클래식과 Nodes 2.0 모두에서 작동합니다. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 왼쪽의 노드들을 모아서, 허브가 OPT_CONNECTION을 통해 전부 한꺼번에 뮤트 또는 바이패스할 수 있게 합니다. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** (JS only) | LC Bypasser, LC Mute, LC Groups Bypasser를 위한 위젯 전용 리모컨입니다. |
| **LC Bypasser** (JS only) | 토글이나 BOOLEAN 입력으로 연결된 노드들을 한곳에서 바이패스합니다. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB 채널을 어긋나게 옮겨서 렌즈 색수차를 흉내 냅니다. 채널별 픽셀 양과 방향을 정할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 이미지의 색을 레퍼런스에 맞춥니다 (AdaIN / mean-std). 피부 보호와 마스크는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 다른 노드의 combo(sampler, scheduler 등)에 연결하면 그 옵션을 그대로 반영하는 드롭다운입니다. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 노드 하나에 최대 16개의 슬라이더와 on/off 스위치가 있고, 각각 별도의 출력을 가집니다. 행의 톱니바퀴로 타입(숫자 또는 boolean), 이름, 범위, step, INT 또는 FLOAT를 설정합니다. 숫자나 boolean 입력에 연결한 새 행은 그 입력의 설정을 복사합니다. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 나만의 옵션 목록을 만들고, 선택한 텍스트와 그 index를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 다른 곳에서 LC Custom Combo의 선택을 고르는 리모컨입니다. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | 샘플러에 주는 것과 같은 denoise 값으로, 1에서 denoise 값을 뺀 만큼의 비율로 latent 노이즈를 주입합니다. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | depth map으로 대기 안개, 빛 감싸기, 진짜 보케가 있는 피사계 심도를 만들며 공용 룩을 지원합니다. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 원래 Detail Daemon 스케줄에 따라 일부 steps 구간 동안 모델에게 노이즈를 조금 숨겨서 세밀한 디테일을 추가합니다. Look only(기본값), classic, keep structure 모드가 있습니다. 샘플러 버전이며 low pass 샘플러에 연결합니다. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 같은 Detail Daemon을 model patch로 만든 버전으로, 일반 KSampler용입니다. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE에서 디테일러 설정(모델, 프롬프트, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps)을 풀어냅니다. protect_mask (맨 아래): pipe 디테일러가 다시 그린 영역. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | width와 height에 하나의 값을 더하거나, 빼거나, 곱하거나, 나누고 결과를 정수로 반올림합니다. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 노드의 화살표를 드래그해서 정한 각도와 길이로 모션 블러를 줍니다. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 이미지 A 위에 이미지 B를 겹치고, 한 번 실행한 뒤 다시 생성하지 않고 노드에서 불투명도를 조절할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | 기본 Save Image 노드용 filename_prefix를 만들고 폴더를 생성합니다. |
| **LC Film Grain** | amount, contrast, size, 모노 또는 컬러 옵션으로 필름 그레인을 추가합니다. |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | 클립 전체에 같은 그레인을 입힙니다: GPU에서 몇 프레임씩, 진행 막대와 함께. 그레인 크기가 영상에 맞춰져서 압축해도 살아남습니다. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | 프리셋과 strength 블렌드로 흑백 필름 룩을 줍니다. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | 프리셋(toe, shoulder, gamma)과 strength 블렌드로 컬러 필름 룩을 줍니다. |
| **LC Float Compare** | 두 float 중 큰 쪽 또는 작은 쪽을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | 모델이 학습된 표 형식으로 박스를 Flux 3 프롬프트에 추가합니다. 프롬프트에 <1>, <2>라고 쓰면 박스 1, 박스 2를 가리킵니다. |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | Flux 3용 레퍼런스 그림을 최대 4장까지 positive와 negative에 붙이고, 모델이 필요로 하는 negative와 latent 크기를 만들어 줍니다. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 이미지의 width, height, 메가픽셀, 긴 변, 배치 크기, 종횡비를 읽어옵니다. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** (JS only) | 그룹마다 토글 하나로 전체 그룹을 한곳에서 바이패스합니다. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 기본 컬러 그레이드(hue, saturation, brightness, contrast)와 약한 샤픈 또는 소프트닝. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | 폴더 전체를 알파벳순으로 하나의 배치로 불러오며, max_images와 start_index를 지원합니다. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 컴팩트한 드롭다운과 고정된 이미지 영역으로 대량의 이미지 배치를 비교합니다. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | 노드 위에서 박스와 핸들을 드래그해 크롭하며, 종횡비 고정은 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | blur strength, 엣지 보존, 블렌드를 갖춘 스마트 디노이즈. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | factor와 휘도 방식으로 흑백 쪽으로 채도를 낮춥니다. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 이미지 배치를 격자로 배열하며, gap, 윤곽선, 테두리는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **LC Image Label** | 워크플로에 주석을 다는 떠다니는 이미지 스티커입니다. 드래그 앤 드롭으로 업로드합니다(소켓 없음). |
| **LC Image Pass** | 이미지를 그대로 통과시킵니다. 끄면 다음 노드는 그 입력에서 아무것도 받지 않고, 그것 없이 실행됩니다. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 최대 16개의 레퍼런스 이미지를 하나의 pipe로 묶습니다. 소켓은 Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1처럼 늘어납니다. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | 이미지 ref pipe를 원래 슬롯 그대로 image_1에서 image_16으로 풀어내며, pipe가 먼저 나옵니다. |
| **LC Image RGB** | 각 컬러 채널을 따로 오프셋하며 전체 strength가 있습니다. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | 노드 위의 전/후 비교 와이프이며, 출력은 저장용으로 구워진 분할 이미지입니다. 구분선의 너비와 색은 직접 정할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | 자동으로 늘어나는 슬롯의 이미지를 나란히 또는 위아래로 이어 붙입니다. 크기 맞춤, 정렬, 선택적 gap을 지원합니다. |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 이미지를 총 메가픽셀 수에 맞게 스케일하고 결과 해상도를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 이미지 및/또는 마스크를 프리셋, 사용자 지정 크기, 배수, 메가픽셀 수로 리사이즈하며, divisible_by의 배수로 맞춥니다. |
| **LC Int Compare** | 두 정수 중 큰 쪽 또는 작은 쪽을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Int Split** | 합계를 분할 비율에 따라 a + b로 나누므로 a + b는 항상 합계와 같습니다. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | boolean, int, float를 변환하고 반대 값을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | 연결된 노드가 바이패스 또는 뮤트되어 있으면 true를 출력하며, 큐에 넣지 않고도 실시간으로 읽습니다. |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | 여러 문자열을 구분자로 이어 붙이며 빈 것은 건너뜁니다. |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | 노드 위에서 RGB 영역을 칠하면 krea2 CLIP 타입으로 regional conditioning을 얻을 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | 워크플로에 주석을 다는 떠다니는 텍스트 라벨입니다. 폰트, 색상, 외곽선, 그림자를 지원합니다(소켓 없음). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | 연결을 끊은 뒤에도 마지막으로 생성된 이미지를 보관해 전/후 비교를 할 수 있습니다. Hold until seed change는 seed의 첫 이미지를 유지해서 수정한 결과를 비교할 수 있게 합니다. |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)** | 검색에서 숨겨져 있습니다. 예전 워크플로는 계속 실행됩니다. 대신 Lens Profile, Vignette, Film Grain을 쓰세요. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | 이름이 붙은 렌즈 프로파일을 조절 가능한 strength로 적용하거나 보정합니다. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | lift, gamma, gain, offset으로 섀도, 미드톤, 하이라이트를 그레이딩합니다. |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | 스팟 또는 태양광 1~2개, 따뜻함, 컬러 젤, 하드 또는 소프트 그림자로 이미지를 리라이트합니다. |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | 예전 워크플로우에서는 계속 작동합니다. 대신 LC Lighting Control V2를 쓰세요. |
| **LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader와 같은 LoRA 목록을 만들어 LORA_STACK으로 출력합니다. |
| **LC LoRA Loader 🎚️** | 노드 하나에서 원하는 만큼의 LoRA를 적용하며, 행마다 enable, strength, 드래그로 순서 변경이 있습니다. |
| **LC LoRA Loader (single) 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader 한 줄(켜기/끄기, 폴더 선택기, 강도, Info)로, turbo나 스타일 LoRA를 따로 한 자리에 둡니다. 모델 전용이며 줄 추가나 삭제는 없습니다. |
| **LC Mask Pass** | 마스크를 통과시킵니다. 끄면 다음 노드는 마스크 없이 실행됩니다. 마스크를 만드는 노드를 바이패스하는 대신 이것을 쓰세요. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe** | MiniMax H3의 프롬프트, 레퍼런스, 설정을 담은 H3 pipe를 만들거나 편집합니다. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | LC MiniMax H3 pipe를 별도 소켓으로 풀어냅니다. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2** | H3 pipe V2를 풀어내며 prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler, scheduler 출력이 추가됩니다. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2** | prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler, scheduler도 함께 담는 H3 pipe V2를 만들거나 편집합니다. |
| **LC Model Info ℹ️** | MODEL을 아무거나 연결하세요: 와이어를 따라 업스트림(LoRA 로더, 머지, LC Model Optimizer)으로 올라가며 각 파일의 헤더만 읽습니다. 저장 노드가 구워 넣은 워크플로우(베이스 모델, strength가 있는 LoRA, 머지), Kohya 학습 정보와 트리거 태그, 카드 필드, GGUF 타입을 보여 줍니다. 노드에서 실시간으로 확인되며 큐에 넣을 필요가 없습니다. 모델은 그대로 통과합니다. |
| **LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡** | LC Model Optimizer와 같고 LC_PIPE 출력이 추가됩니다 (model 2는 Ideogram 4의 두 번째 모델을 담습니다). |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | LC Model Optimizer Video와 같고 LC_PIPE 출력이 추가됩니다 (vae 2는 오디오 VAE를 담습니다). |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | 비디오 버전입니다. MiniMax H3와 LTX 2.5 / 2.3용으로 모델, 텍스트 인코더, 비디오와 오디오 VAE, latent 업스케일러를 불러옵니다. H3에서는 Spectrum과 Veda가 설치되어 있으면 켤 수 있습니다(spectrum / veda 위젯). |
| **LC Model Optimizer ⚡** | 카드에 맞는 모델, 텍스트 인코더, VAE를 그 카드에서 통하는 가속과 함께 불러옵니다. 첫 실행 때 추천 파일을 내려받습니다. Krea 2(Turbo와 Raw), SDXL, Illustrious, Pony 등을 지원하고, 그 밖의 모델은 Custom으로 쓸 수 있습니다. MOSS Image와 Krea 2에는 Spectrum이 내장되어 있습니다(spectrum 위젯으로 끌 수 있음). |
| **LC MOSS Layout Prompt 🗺️** | 박스를 MOSS Image의 레이아웃 프롬프트로 바꿉니다. 물체, 캐릭터, 텍스트가 각자의 캡션과 팔레트를 가지고 그린 자리에 그대로 놓입니다. 캔버스(단일, 멀티 패널, 콜라주), 매체 태그와 팔레트를 더하고, 박스를 그린 크기를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Mute** (JS only) | LC Bypasser처럼 작동하지만, Off로 하면 연결된 노드를 바이패스하는 대신 뮤트합니다. |
| **LC Natural Look 🍃** | AI 느낌을 걷어냅니다. 가장 튀는 색만 눌러 주고, 주황빛 피부와 플라스틱 같은 피부를 차분하게 하고, 하이라이트를 부드럽게 굴리고, 번들거리는 광택을 줄이고 미세한 질감을 살립니다(밋밋한 피부는 제외). 블랙 포인트, 대비, 밝기는 그대로 두고 아주 약한 그레인을 더합니다. |
| **LC Negative** | negative 프롬프트 텍스트 박스. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | 다른 노드의 위젯을 읽어서 선택한 값, 모든 줄, 또는 JSON을 출력합니다. |
| **LC Note 📝** (JS only) | 클릭하면 LC Vision을 통해 ComfyUI의 14개 언어로 번역되는 마크다운 노트이며, @[card](link) 줄은 링크 카드로 표시합니다. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | 노드가 실행될 때 선택한 소리를 재생합니다 (항상, 큐가 비었을 때, 또는 안 함). |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37가지 폰 앱 필터 프리셋(1977, Aden, Brooklyn 등)과 strength, 노드 위 와이프. |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | 스타일 프리셋, 슬라이더, strength 블렌드로 이미지에 폰 카메라 룩을 줍니다. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | 값을 LC_PIPE에 담거나, 기존 pipe에 오버라이드를 합칩니다. |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | 두 번째 pipe로 맨 위 pipe를 편집합니다: edit pipe가 가진 것은 맨 위 pipe를 덮어쓰고, 나머지는 그대로 따라갑니다. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE를 개별 소켓으로 펼치고 pipe는 그대로 넘깁니다. protect_mask (맨 아래): pipe 디테일러가 다시 그린 영역. |

| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | 이미 저장한 모델에서 메타데이터(내장 워크플로우, 학습 정보, 제목)를 청소합니다. 가중치는 바이트 단위로 그대로 복사되며 불러오지 않으므로, 이전과 똑같이 로드됩니다. _clean 복사본을 쓰거나 원본을 대체합니다. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 같은 latent를 최대 여섯 개의 VAE로 디코딩해서, 1:1 디테일 크롭, 선명도 수치, 각각이 첫 번째에서 얼마나 떨어져 있는지와 함께 나란히 보여 줍니다. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 같은 계열의 두 VAE 디코더를 큰 형태부터 미세한 질감까지 머지합니다. 인코더는 base의 것이 유지되어서, 결과물이 그 VAE용으로 만든 모델에 그대로 맞습니다. |
| **LC VAE Save** | VAE를 fp32, bf16, fp16으로 models/vae에 저장합니다. |

## LC123 v1.54.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for CivitAI's terms). Off until you switch it on. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |

| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |

| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bounding Boxes 🔲** | Draw boxes on a picture for Flux 3 or MOSS Image: name each box, pick new, change, move or remove, and describe the result. For MOSS a box can be a character and get its own palette. Works in classic and Nodes 2.0. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** (JS only) | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser. |
| **LC Bypasser** (JS only) | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | Up to 16 sliders and on/off switches on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its type (number or boolean), name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number or boolean input copies that input's settings. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | Uses a depth map for atmospheric haze, light wrap and depth of field with real bokeh, with shared looks. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | Adds fine detail by hiding a little of the noise from the model over a window of the steps, on the original Detail Daemon schedule. Look only (default), classic and keep structure modes. Sampler version. Goes on the low pass sampler. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | The same Detail Daemon as a model patch, for a plain KSampler. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a filename_prefix for the native Save Image node and creates the folders. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options. |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | The same grain for a whole clip: GPU, a few frames at a time, with a progress bar. Grain sized to the video, so it survives compression. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats. |
| **LC Flux 3 Layout Prompt 🗺️** | Adds the boxes to a Flux 3 prompt as the table the model was trained on. Write <1>, <2> in the prompt for box 1, box 2. |
| **LC Flux 3 Reference Latent 🖼️** | Up to 4 reference pictures for Flux 3 on the positive and negative, the negative the model wants and the latent size. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** (JS only) | Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | Loads a whole folder as one batch in alphabetical order, with max_images and start_index. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border. |
| **LC Image Label** | A floating image sticker with drag-and-drop upload for annotating a workflow (no sockets). |
| **LC Image Pass** | Passes an image straight through. Turned off, the next node sees nothing on that input and runs without it. |

| **LC Int Split** | Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total. |

| **LC Label 🏷️** | A floating text label for annotating a workflow, with fonts, color, outline and shadow (no sockets). |

| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset. |

| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | Old workflows still run it. Use LC Lighting Control V2 instead. |

Shows the workflow a save node baked in (base models, LoRAs with strengths, merges), Kohya training info and trigger tags, card fields, GGUF type. Live on the node, no queue needed. The model passes through. |

Covers Krea 2 (Turbo and Raw), SDXL, Illustrious, Pony and more, plus Custom for any other model. Built-in Spectrum on MOSS Image and Krea 2 (spectrum widget to opt out). |

| **LC Stop 🛑** | A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color. |

| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Runs up to twenty find and replace pairs (optionally regex) on a text. |

| **LC Vibrance** | Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection. |

| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask. |

Give each character its own LoRA branch and detailer, so a character LoRA never bleeds onto the other faces. |

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|

| **LC Anima LoRA Block Scan** | The Krea2 LoRA Block Scan for Anima, scoring anime faces with CCIP. |
| **LC Anima LoRA Editor** | The Krea2 LoRA Editor for Anima: same controls, Anima's 28 blocks and layer types. |
| **LC Anima LoRA Merge** | The Krea2 LoRA Merge for Anima: two to four Anima LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve. |
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. metadata: keep all, or necessary only (no workflow or training details). |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. Same metadata switch. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. Photo (ArcFace) or anime (CCIP) mode. |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | What is this model made of? Its recipe from your fingerprint library, block by block: which models were merged and at what ratio, merged-in LoRAs with their strength, how sure it is of each, and a heatmap. It can only name what is in the library. |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | Goes through your folders and stores a small fingerprint (about 1 MB) of every model and LoRA, with its family. Once a file is in, the original can go. Reruns only add what is new. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Bake 🍞** | Bakes up to 4 LoRAs into a model file and saves it as a new model, with an optional per-block curve. Reads every LoRA format ComfyUI reads and writes the recipe into the file. Runs on the CPU, no VRAM needed. |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA Save** | Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | One model against a reference, layer by layer, from the weights themselves: the same model at another precision, built on it, a block merge (the chart shows which blocks) or not related. With a LoRA: whether it was merged in and at about what strength. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | Saves a smaller copy of a model: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 or int4 (load with the stock loader) or GGUF Q8_0 to Q2_K. From the wired MODEL (LoRAs baked in) or straight from a file of any size. |
| **LC MOSS Block Merge Advanced** | Merges MOSS Image models with a draggable per-layer ratio curve across the 42 layers, plus sliders for the parts outside them (picture in, prompt in, timestep, modulation, final layer). Presets save and load. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | Cleans the metadata out of a model you already saved (embedded workflow, training details, titles). The weights are copied byte for byte, never loaded, so it loads exactly as before. Writes a _clean copy or replaces the original. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |

## LC123 v1.49.20

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for CivitAI's terms). Off until you switch it on. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. Starts on LC Crushed Blacks at 0.3. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | Up to 16 sliders on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number input copies that input's settings. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | Uses a depth map for atmospheric haze, light wrap and depth of field with real bokeh, with shared looks. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | Adds fine detail by hiding a little of the noise from the model over a window of the steps, on the original Detail Daemon schedule. Look only (default), classic and keep structure modes. Sampler version. Goes on the low pass sampler. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | The same Detail Daemon as a model patch, for a plain KSampler. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a filename_prefix for the native Save Image node and creates the folders. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | Loads a whole folder as one batch in alphabetical order, with max_images and start_index. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border. |
| **LC Image Label** | A floating image sticker with drag-and-drop upload for annotating a workflow (no sockets). |

| **LC Image RGB** | Offsets each color channel separately with an overall strength. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | A before/after wipe on the node whose output is the baked split for saving. |

| **LC Int Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers. |

| **LC Invert Boolean** | Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite. |

| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Joins multiple strings with a delimiter and skips the empty ones. |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get regional conditioning using the krea2 CLIP type. |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | A floating text label for annotating a workflow, with fonts, color, outline and shadow (no sockets). |

| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes. |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦** | Relights an image from a normal map and a depth map with virtual lights, shadows and an optional subject mask. |

| **LC Mute** | Works like LC Bypasser, but Off mutes the linked nodes instead of bypassing them. |
| **LC Natural Look 🍃** | Takes the AI look out: pulls back only the loudest colours, calms orange and plastic skin, rolls the highlights off, cuts the glossy glow and lifts fine texture, with your black point, contrast and brightness kept and a whisper of grain. |
| **LC Negative** | A negative prompt text box. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | Reads another node's widgets and outputs the selected value, all lines, or JSON. |
| **LC Note 📝** | A markdown note that translates into ComfyUI's 14 languages on click through LC Vision, and shows @[card](link) lines as link cards. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never). |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37 phone-app filter presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.) with strength and an on-node wipe. |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | Gives an image a phone-camera look from a style preset, with sliders and a strength blend. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | Packs values into an LC_PIPE, or merges overrides into an existing pipe. |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | Edits the top pipe with a second pipe: whatever the edit pipe carries overwrites the top one, everything else rides along. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Expands an LC_PIPE into individual sockets and passes the pipe on. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Positive** | A positive prompt text box. |
| **LC Preview Image 🖼️** | Previews an image and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **LC Preview Mask 🎭** | Previews a mask and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **🧩LC Prompt Assembler** | Assembles the prompt builder pieces (subject, camera, lighting, style, scene) into one prompt or JSON. |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Encodes a prompt into conditioning and also outputs a zeroed copy for the negative. |
| **LC Reference Latent** | Attaches up to eight reference latents to conditioning. |
| **LC Sampler Configure** | Central dual-pass sampler settings: steps, swap point, detailer steps, denoise, CFGs, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Dual-pass sampler settings with an optional pipe in and a pipe out. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC_PIPE into the sampler configure sockets, plus the latent. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple** | Single-pass sampler settings with one CFG and no step swap. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)** | Simple sampler settings that read from and write to an LC_PIPE. |
| **LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️** | Pick the sampler and scheduler once and wire them to every KSampler, so they all change together. |
| **LC Save Image 💾** | Saves images with workflow metadata, and CivitAI parameters when paired with LC Save Metadata. |
| **LC Save Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the metadata (models, AIR or URL, settings) that LC Save Image writes. |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Writes a text string to a file in the output folder. |
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Builds a scene description from scene presets and objects. |
| **🌱LC Seed** | A utility seed with a mode that also works when you queue only this node. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | Takes a seed and a jump value and outputs the seed plus five successive jumps. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | Undoes softness (deconvolution) with texture and clarity, halo control and skin protection. Presets for photos, line art, anime and illustration. |
| **LC Show Any 🔤** | Shows any value on the node and passes it through with its type unchanged. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Shows a string on the node and passes it on. |
| **LC Sigma Curve** | Draw a custom sigma curve on the node, save it, and reuse it. |
| **LC Sigma Resample** | Resamples a sigma curve to a new step count while keeping its start and end sigma (also registered as LCChangeStepCount). |
| **LC Sigmas (BETA)** | One scheduler for one- and two-pass sampling: sigma curve presets (base, beta, flowmatch, hyperbolic, gaussian, your saved curves) you can bend by dragging the graph, step swap, denoise, continue or renoise on the second pass, and sigma shift. Takes regular and RES4LYF / ClownShark sampler names. |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | Cools, brightens and evens skin in LAB with presets, protecting highlights, with an optional mask. Runs on GPU or CPU. |
| **LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)** | Adds real pore texture to skin that came out too smooth, from a real skin photo (only its fine relief, never its colour). Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Skin Upscale** | Upscales only the masked skin area with a CNN model and blends it back. Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Slider** | A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float. |
| **LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀** | About 2x faster sampling (about 1.4x on SDXL / Pony / Illustrious), same quality: the picture starts at half size and grows to full size partway through. Plug it into the high pass sampler. |
| **LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)** | A KSampler with Speed Boost built in. Same inputs, plus start / end at step so it can chain into another sampler. Takes ClownShark (RES4LYF) samplers. |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Splits sigmas between two models for a dual-model SamplerCustomAdvanced. |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | Splits sigma curves at a swap step into a high and a low set. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Picks a style preset (and quality level) for a prompt and adds your own notes. |
| **🗒️LC Subject** | Describes the subject of a prompt with freeform text plus pose, action, outfit and placement options. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Combines several subject outputs into one line. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color. |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | Removes up to twenty substrings from a text, in order. |
| **LC ✂️ Duplicate Tags 🏷️** | Removes repeated tags so none gets double weight (long_hair = (long hair:1.2)). Optional second prompt to merge two and clean them together. |
| **LC 🚦** | A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). Colors behind the gear. |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Runs up to twenty find and replace pairs (optionally regex) on a text. |
| **LC Timer ⏱️** | Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. Stopped and fully cached runs are left out. |
| **LC Tone Match** | Keeps the reference's broad lighting and color while keeping the image's fine detail, with an optional mask. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection. |
| **LC Vignette** | Darkens or brightens the edges of the image. |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask. |
| **LC Widget To String** | Reads a widget on another node as a string. |
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Picks a random line from a wildcard text file. |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | Encodes a text prompt into CLIP conditioning. |

---

## LC AV v0.3.12

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Audio Channel 🎚️** | Splits stereo audio into left and right, and duplicates mono to both. |
| **LC Audio Crop ✂️** | Crops audio from a start time to an end time (MM:SS). |
| **LC Audio Duration ⏱️** | Outputs the audio length as seconds and minutes, as int and float. |
| **LC Audio EQ 3-Band 🎛️** | A 3-band equalizer with a low shelf, a peaking mid and a high shelf. |
| **LC Audio Separate 🎼** | Splits audio into Bass, Drums, Other and Vocals stems with Hybrid Demucs. |
| **LC Audio Volume 🔊** | Changes audio volume with a slider and soft-clips after the gain. |
| **LC AV Pipe (in/edit) 🎬** | Packs or edits an LC_AV_PIPE holding video, audio and settings. |
| **LC AV Pipe Out 🎬** | Unpacks an LC_AV_PIPE into its slots and passes the av_pipe on. |
| **LC Create Video 🎬** | Builds an LC_AV_PIPE from an image batch (it does not encode a file). |
| **LC Final Frame 🖼️** | Outputs the last frame of an image batch. |
| **LC Get Latent Size 📐** | Reads the pixel width and height of a latent, plus batch and frames for video latents. |
| **LC Load Audio 📂** | Loads audio from the input folder with start and end trim and a preview player. |
| **LC Pipe → AV Pipe 🔌** | Converts an LC_PIPE or MiniMax H3 pipe into an LC_AV_PIPE, copying only the shared fields. |
| **LC Save Video Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the same metadata as LC Save Metadata, for LC Save Image or LC Save Video. |
| **LC Save Video 💾** | Saves video with Video Combine style options (frame rate, loop, format, pingpong, crf, pix_fmt, audio). |
| **LC VAE Decode 🧩** | A VAE Decode with a switch between full and tiled decoding. |

---

## LC MaskMaker v0.19.2

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels (per channel, luminance, saturation or mono) with trims, a strength blend and an optional mask. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draws a mask right on the node with points or a freehand pencil, with feather, invert and opacity built in. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Makes a Depth Anything V2 depth map (bright = near) as an image and a mask. Model list reads the same on every machine. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well instead of a blind centre crop, using the Aspect Ratio Simplifier presets. Framing from widest to face only. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Places a layer on a background (position, scale, rotate, mirror) and blends it with 29 blend modes through an optional mask. |
| **LC Image Rotate + Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node. The mask covers the padding and the corners a turn opens up. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with the AnyPaint LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was, and the seam disappears. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Z-Image (Turbo / Base), painted by the Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch instead of a LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any SDXL checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious), painted by ControlNet Union ProMax, Fooocus inpaint optional. No LoRA needed. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tightens a mask with a trimap, using a guided filter or VITMatte on the edge band only, with a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Makes a BAE surface normal map (RGB = XYZ), the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node to build a grey canvas and a mask of the new area. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Selects parts of a person (face, hair, body, clothes, accessories, background) with Segformer or MediaPipe. remove_features makes a skin-only mask. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Removes the background with BiRefNet and outputs an RGBA cutout, the mask and the subject on a solid color. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Selects things by describing them, using GroundingDINO + SAM or SAM 3, with optional edge refine. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact detailers. Finds what you type (hands, face, eyes) with SAM 3 and redraws each one in its own upscaled crop, then blends it back in. |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | The same, with model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe. A wired model or VAE overrides the pipe's. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |

---

## LC Vision v1.2.14

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | Prompts for SDXL, Pony and Illustrious from one image or a rough idea: a short or detailed caption, real Danbooru tags, or a sentence plus tags. Optional quality tags and a matching negative. |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). |

---

## LC ModelBuilder v0.4.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are with ArcFace (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA Save** | 🧪 BETA, still in testing. Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
